english: That World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, when practicing the Bodhisattva path, made great vows, and the meritorious adornments of that Buddha land - even if I were to speak for one kalpa, or more than one kalpa, I could not exhaust describing them.

chinese: 然彼佛土，一向清淨，無有女人，亦無惡趣，及苦音聲。
english: Yet that Buddha-land is entirely pure, without women, without evil destinies, and without sounds of suffering.

chinese: 琉璃為地，金繩界道，城、闕、宮、閣、軒、窓、羅網，皆七寶成。
english: The ground is made of lapis lazuli, with golden cords marking the pathways. The cities, towers, palaces, pavilions, galleries, windows, and nets are all made of the seven treasures.

chinese: 亦如西方極樂世界，功德莊嚴，等無差別。
english: Just like the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, with its meritorious virtues and adornments, there is no difference whatsoever.

chinese: 於其國中，有二菩薩摩訶薩：一名日光遍照，二名月光遍照，是彼無量無數菩薩眾之上首，能持彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來正法寶藏。
english: In that country, there are two great bodhisattva-mahasattvas: the first is named Universal Illumination of Sunlight, the second is named Universal Illumination of Moonlight. They are the foremost leaders among that immeasurable and countless assembly of bodhisattvas, and are able to uphold the treasury of the true Dharma of that World-Honored One, the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata.

chinese: 是故，曼殊室利！
english: Therefore, Mañjuśrī!

chinese: 諸有信心善男子、善女人等，應當願生彼佛世界。
english: All good men and good women who have faith should aspire to be reborn in that Buddha's world.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊復告曼殊利童子言：「曼殊室利！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One again addressed Mañjuśrī the Youth, saying: "Mañjuśrī!"

chinese: 有諸眾生，不識善惡，唯懷貪悋，不知布施及施果報，愚癡無智，闕於信根，多聚財寶，勤加守護；見乞者來，其心不喜，設不獲已而行施時，如割身肉，深生痛惜。
english: There are many sentient beings who do not recognize good and evil, who harbor only greed and stinginess, who do not understand generosity or the karmic rewards of giving, who are foolish and lacking wisdom, who are deficient in the root of faith, who accumulate much wealth and diligently guard it. When they see beggars approaching, their hearts are displeased. If circumstances force them to give, it is like cutting their own flesh - they feel deep pain and regret.

chinese: 復有無量慳貪有情，積集資財，於其自身尚不受用，何況能與父母、妻子、奴婢、作使，及來乞者？
english: Furthermore, there are countless sentient beings afflicted by greed and stinginess who accumulate wealth and possessions, yet do not even use them for themselves - how much less would they give to their parents, wives, children, servants, workers, and beggars?

chinese: 彼諸有情，從此命終，生餓鬼界，或生趣。
english: Those sentient beings, after dying from here, are born in the realm of hungry ghosts, or are born in [other] destinies.

chinese: 由昔人間，曾得暫聞藥師琉璃光如來名故，在惡趣，暫得憶念彼如來名，即於念時，從彼處沒，還生人中，得宿命念，畏惡趣苦，不樂欲樂，好行惠施，讚歎施者，一切所有悉無貪惜，漸次尚能以頭目手足，血肉身分，施來求者，況餘財物。
english: Because in the past while among humans, they once briefly heard the name of Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, when in the evil destinies, they briefly recall and contemplate that Tathagata's name. At the very moment of contemplation, they pass away from that place and are reborn among humans, obtaining memory of past lives. Fearing the suffering of evil destinies, taking no pleasure in sensual pleasures, they delight in practicing generosity, praise those who give, and have no greed or attachment to any possessions. Gradually they become able to give even their heads, eyes, hands, feet, blood, flesh, and body parts to those who seek them - how much more so their other material possessions.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利，若諸有情，雖於如來受諸學處，而破尸羅；有雖不破尸羅，而破軌則；有於尸羅、軌則，雖得不壞，然毀正見；有雖不毀正見，而棄多聞，於佛所說契經深義不能解了；有雖多聞而上慢，由增上慢覆蔽心故，自是非他，嫌謗正法，為魔伴黨。
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī, there are sentient beings who, though they have received the precepts from the Tathāgata, break the moral discipline; there are some who, though they do not break the moral discipline, violate the rules of conduct; there are some who, though they maintain the moral discipline and rules of conduct without corruption, destroy right views; there are some who, though they do not destroy right views, abandon extensive learning and cannot understand the profound meaning of the sūtras spoken by the Buddha; there are some who, though learned, develop pride, and due to their hearts being obscured by this excessive pride, consider themselves right and others wrong, disparage the true Dharma, and become companions of Māra.

chinese: 如是愚人，自行邪見，復令無量俱胝有情，墮大險坑。
english: Thus these foolish people, practicing wrong views themselves, also cause countless millions of sentient beings to fall into the great pit of danger.

chinese: 此諸有情，應於地獄、傍生、鬼趣，流轉無窮。
english: These sentient beings should endlessly transmigrate through the hell realms, animal realms, and hungry ghost realms.

chinese: 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，便捨惡行，修諸善法，不墮惡趣，設有不能捨諸惡行，修行善法，墮惡趣者，以彼如來本願威力，令其現前暫聞名號，從彼命終還生人趣，得正見精進，善調意樂，便能捨家趣於非家，如來法中，受持學處，無有毀犯；正見多聞，解甚深義，離增上慢，不謗正法，不為魔，漸次修行諸菩薩行，速得圓滿。
english: If one hears the name of this Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, they will abandon evil conduct and cultivate various wholesome practices, not falling into evil destinies. Even if there are those who cannot abandon evil conduct and cultivate wholesome practices and fall into evil destinies, through the power of that Tathagata's original vows, they will be caused to hear his name briefly in their present life. After death, they will be reborn in the human realm, obtaining right view and diligence, with well-disciplined minds and aspirations. They will then be able to leave home and enter homelessness, receive and uphold the precepts in the Tathagata's Dharma without violation, possess right view and extensive learning, understand profound meanings, be free from arrogance, not slander the true Dharma, not become demons, gradually cultivate the bodhisattva practices, and swiftly attain perfection.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 若諸有情，慳貪嫉妬，自讚毀他，當墮三惡趣中，無量千歲受諸劇苦；受劇苦已，從彼命終，來生人間，作牛、馬、駝、驢，恒被鞭撻，飢渴逼惱；又負重，隨路而行。
english: If sentient beings are stingy, greedy, and jealous, praising themselves while slandering others, they will fall into the three evil destinies, where for countless thousands of years they will suffer intense agonies. After enduring such severe suffering, when they die there and are reborn in the human realm, they become oxen, horses, camels, or donkeys, constantly whipped and beaten, tormented by hunger and thirst, and bearing heavy burdens as they travel along the roads.

chinese: 或得為人，生居下，作人奴婢，受他驅役，恒不自在。
english: If one is reborn as a human, they will be born into a low status, becoming a slave or servant to others, subject to their commands and control, forever lacking freedom.

chinese: 若昔人中，曾聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，由此善因，復憶念，至心歸依。
english: If in the past, among people, one has heard the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, due to this good cause, they will again remember and, with sincere mind, take refuge.

chinese: 以佛神力，眾苦解脫，諸根聰利，智慧多聞，恒求勝法，常遇善友，永斷魔羂，破無明，竭煩惱河，解脫一切生、老、病、死，憂、苦惱。
english: Through the Buddha's divine power, all sufferings are liberated, all faculties become sharp and keen, wisdom and learning increase, constantly seeking supreme Dharma, always encountering good friends, forever severing Mara's snares, breaking through ignorance, exhausting the river of afflictions, and gaining liberation from all birth, aging, sickness, death, worry, and anguish.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!"

chinese: 若諸有情，好憙乖離，更相鬪訟，惱亂自他，以身語意，造作增長種種惡業，展轉常為不饒益事，互相謀害。
english: If sentient beings delight in discord and separation, engaging in mutual disputes and litigation, causing distress to themselves and others, creating and increasing various evil karmas through body, speech, and mind, they will continuously turn toward non-beneficial matters, plotting harm against one another.

chinese: 告召山林樹塚等神；殺諸眾生，取其血肉，祭祀藥叉剎等；書怨人名，作其形像，以惡呪術而呪之；厭媚蠱道，呪起屍鬼，令斷彼命，及壞其身。
english: Summoning the spirits of mountains, forests, trees, and burial mounds; killing various living beings and taking their blood and flesh to offer sacrifices to yakṣas and rākṣasas; writing down the names of enemies and making images of their forms, then cursing them with evil spells; using sorcery and witchcraft, invoking corpse demons to cut off their lives and destroy their bodies.

chinese: 是諸有情，若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，彼諸惡事，悉不能害。
english: When those sentient beings hear the name of Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, all those evil things will be unable to harm them.

chinese: 一切展轉皆起慈心，利益安樂，無損惱意及嫌恨心；各各歡悅，於自所受生於喜足，不相侵，互為饒益。
english: All beings reciprocally give rise to loving-kindness, bringing benefit and happiness, without any intention to harm or vex, and without resentment or hatred. Each rejoices and feels content with what they have received, not encroaching upon one another, mutually acting for each other's benefit.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!

chinese: 若有四眾：苾芻、苾芻尼、鄔波索迦、鄔波斯迦，及餘淨信善男子、善女人等，有能受持八分齋戒，經一年，或復三月，受持學處，以此善根，願生西方極樂世界無量壽佛所，聽聞正法，而未定者。
english: If there are the four assemblies—bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, and upāsikās—and other faithful good men and good women who are able to uphold the eight-precept fast for one year or for three months, maintaining the training precepts, and with these good roots aspire to be born in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss where Amitāyus Buddha dwells, to hear the true Dharma, but are not yet certain [of rebirth there].

chinese: 若聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，臨命終時，有八薩，來，示其道路，即於彼界種種雜色眾寶華中，自然化生。
english: If one hears the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, at the time of death, eight bodhisattvas will come and show the way, and one will spontaneously be reborn by transformation among various multicolored jeweled flowers in that realm.

chinese: 或有因此生於天上，雖生天中，而本善根亦未窮盡，不復更生諸餘惡趣。
english: Some, because of this, are born in the heavens above. Though born in the heavens, their original good roots are not yet exhausted, and they will not be reborn again in the other evil destinies.

chinese: 天上壽盡，還生人間，或為輪王，統攝四洲，威德自在，安立無量百千有情於十善道；或生剎帝利、婆羅門、居士大家，多饒財寶，倉庫盈溢，形相端嚴，眷屬具足，聰明智慧，勇健威猛，如大力士。
english: When their lifespan in heaven is exhausted, they are reborn in the human realm, either as wheel-turning kings ruling over the four continents, possessing majestic virtue and sovereign power, establishing countless hundreds of thousands of sentient beings in the ten wholesome paths; or they are born into kshatriya, brahmin, or great householder families, abundantly wealthy with treasures, their storehouses overflowing, with beautiful forms, complete retinues, intelligence and wisdom, brave and mighty, like great warriors.

chinese: 若是女人，得聞世尊藥師名號，至心受持，於後不復更受女身。
english: If a woman hears the name of the World-Honored One Medicine Master and accepts and upholds it with utmost sincerity, she will never again receive a female body in the future.

chinese: 」時，曼殊室利童子白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Manjushri, the youthful one, addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 我當誓於像法轉時，以種種方便，令諸淨信善男子、善女人等，得聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，乃至睡中亦以佛名覺悟其耳。
english: I vow that during the time of the Semblance Dharma, through various skillful means, I will enable faithful good men and good women to hear the name of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and even in their sleep, I will awaken their ears with the Buddha's name.

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若於此經受持讀誦，或復為他演說開示；若自書，若人書；恭敬尊重，以種種花香、塗香、香、燒香、花鬘、瓔珞、幡蓋、伎樂，而為供養；以五色綵，作囊盛之；掃灑淨處，敷設高座，而用安處。
english: If one upholds, reads, and recites this sutra, or explains and expounds it for others; if one copies it oneself or has others copy it; if one shows reverence and respect by making offerings with various flowers, perfumes, ointments, powdered incense, burning incense, flower garlands, necklaces, banners, canopies, and music; if one makes a bag of five-colored silk to contain it; if one sweeps and sprinkles clean a place, sets up a high seat, and places it there with care.

chinese: 爾時，四大天王與其眷屬，及餘無量百千天眾，皆詣其所，供養守護。
english: At that time, the Four Great Heavenly Kings together with their retinues, as well as countless hundreds of thousands of other celestial beings, all came to that place to make offerings and provide protection.

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若此經寶流行之處，有能受持，以彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來本願功德，及聞名號，當知是處無復橫死；亦復不為諸惡鬼神，奪其精氣；設已奪者，還得如故，身心安樂。
english: Wherever this precious sutra circulates, if there are those who can uphold it, then through the power of the original vows and merits of the World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and through hearing his name, you should know that in that place there will be no more untimely deaths. Moreover, evil spirits and demons will not steal their vital essence; and even if it has already been stolen, it will be restored as before, with body and mind at peace and happiness.

chinese: 」佛告曼殊室利：「如是！
english: The Buddha said to Manjusri: "It is so!"

chinese: 如是！
english: Just so!

chinese: 如汝所說。
english: As you have said.

chinese: 曼殊室利！
english: Manjushri!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，欲供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，應先造立彼佛形像，敷清淨座而安處之；散種種花，燒種種香，以種種幢幡莊嚴其處；七日七夜，受八分齋戒，食清淨食，澡浴香潔，著新淨衣，應生無垢濁心，無怒害心，於一切有情，起利益安樂，慈、悲、喜、捨，平等之心，鼓樂歌讚，右繞佛像。
english: If there are faithful good men and good women who wish to make offerings to that World-Honored One, the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, they should first create an image of that Buddha and place it upon a pure seat; scatter various flowers, burn various incenses, and adorn the place with various banners and streamers; for seven days and seven nights, observe the eight-fold precepts, eat pure food, bathe in fragrant water until clean, wear new clean clothes, and should give rise to a mind free from defilement and turbidity, free from anger and harm, and toward all sentient beings generate thoughts of benefit and comfort, with a mind of loving-kindness, compassion, joy, equanimity, and equality, playing music and singing praises while circumambulating the Buddha image to the right.

chinese: 復應念彼如來本願功德，誦此經，思惟其義，演說開示。
english: Again, one should be mindful of that Tathagata's original vows and merits, recite this sutra, contemplate its meaning, and expound and reveal it.

chinese: 隨所樂，一切皆遂：求長壽得長壽，求富饒得富饒，求官位得官位，求男女得男女。
english: Whatever one desires, all shall be fulfilled: Those who seek longevity shall obtain longevity, those who seek wealth shall obtain wealth, those who seek official position shall obtain official position, those who seek sons and daughters shall obtain sons and daughters.

chinese: 若復有人，忽得惡夢，見諸惡相，或怪鳥來集，或於住處，百怪出現；此人若以眾妙資，恭敬供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，惡夢惡相，諸不吉祥，皆悉隱沒，不能為患。
english: If there is someone who suddenly has bad dreams, sees various evil signs, has strange birds gathering, or has hundreds of strange phenomena appearing at their dwelling place - if this person reverently makes offerings to that World-Honored One, Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, with various wonderful materials, then all the bad dreams, evil signs, and inauspicious things will completely disappear and be unable to cause harm.

chinese: 或有水、火、刀、毒、懸嶮、惡象、師子、虎、狼、熊、羆、毒蛇、惡蠍、蜈蚣、蚰、蚊虻等怖；若能至心憶念彼佛，恭敬供養，一切怖畏皆得解脫。
english: If there are fears of water, fire, blades, poison, precipices, evil elephants, lions, tigers, wolves, bears, brown bears, venomous snakes, evil scorpions, centipedes, millipedes, mosquitoes, and gadflies; if one can wholeheartedly remember that Buddha and respectfully make offerings, all fears will be liberated.

chinese: 若他國侵擾，盜賊反亂；憶念恭敬彼如來者，亦皆解脫。
english: If other countries invade and harass, or if bandits and rebels cause disorder, those who remember and revere that Tathagata will also all be liberated.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Mañjuśrī!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，乃至盡形不事餘天，當一心歸佛、法、僧，受持禁戒，若五戒、十戒、菩薩四百戒、苾芻二百五十戒、苾芻尼五百戒，於所受中或有毀犯，怖墮惡趣，若能專念彼佛名號，恭敬供養者，必定不受三惡趣生。
english: If there are faithful good men and good women who, even for their entire lives, do not serve other gods, and single-mindedly take refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha, upholding the precepts - whether the five precepts, ten precepts, the bodhisattva's four hundred precepts, the bhikshu's two hundred and fifty precepts, or the bhikshuni's five hundred precepts - and if among these received precepts some are violated or broken, causing fear of falling into evil destinies, if they can single-mindedly recite that Buddha's name and respectfully make offerings, they will certainly not be reborn in the three evil destinies.

chinese: 或有女人，臨當產時，受於極苦；若能至心稱名禮讚，恭敬供養彼如來者，眾苦皆除。
english: When there are women who, at the time of giving birth, experience extreme suffering; if they can wholeheartedly call upon the name, pay homage, praise, respectfully honor and make offerings to that Tathagata, all suffering will be eliminated.

chinese: 所生之子，身分具足，形色端正，見者歡喜，利根聰明，安隱少病，無有非人，奪其精氣。
english: The children that are born will be complete in their faculties, upright in form and appearance, delightful to behold, sharp in their abilities and intelligent, peaceful and rarely ill, with no non-human beings stealing their vital energy.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告阿難言：「如我稱揚彼佛世尊藥師琉璃光如來所有功德，此是諸佛甚深行處，難可解了，汝為信不？
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Ananda: "The merits and virtues of that Buddha, the World-Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, which I have praised - these are the extremely profound practices of all Buddhas, difficult to comprehend. Do you believe this?"

chinese: 爾時，勝軍大王坐一面已，而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: At that time, King Prasenajit, having sat down to one side, addressed the Buddha saying: "O Greatly Compassionate World-Honored One!"

chinese: 願如來哀愍教授，惟願善逝哀愍教誡，令我長夜證於大義利益安樂。
english: May the Tathāgata compassionately teach and instruct me. May the Well-Gone One compassionately teach and admonish me, so that I may realize the great meaning through the long night, attaining benefit and happiness.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告大王曰：「善哉，善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to the Great King: "Excellent, excellent!"

chinese: 大王！
english: Great King!

chinese: 汝今乃能請問如來如是大義。
english: You are now able to ask the Tathagata about such profound meaning.

chinese: 大王！
english: Your Majesty!

chinese: 汝今為大國主，應以正法勿以邪法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: You are now the ruler of a great nation. You should govern with righteous law, not with evil law. You should act in accordance with the Dharma, not in accordance with what is contrary to the Dharma.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 若有國王或諸王等，棄捨正法以諸邪法而作國王，彼於現在為諸聖賢之所訶毀，後致憂悔，身壞命終墮諸惡趣，生地獄中受諸劇苦；又若國王或諸王等，棄捨邪法以其正法而作國王，彼於現在為眾聖賢之所稱讚，後無憂悔，身壞命終超昇善趣，生諸天中受諸妙樂。
english: If there are kings or various rulers who abandon the correct Dharma and rule their kingdoms using evil laws, they will be criticized and condemned by all sages and worthies in this present life, will later experience regret and sorrow, and when their bodies perish and their lives end, they will fall into evil destinies and be born in the hells where they will suffer intense pain. Moreover, if kings or various rulers abandon evil laws and rule their kingdoms using the correct Dharma, they will be praised by all sages and worthies in this present life, will have no regret or sorrow later, and when their bodies perish and their lives end, they will ascend to good destinies and be born among the heavens where they will enjoy sublime pleasures.

chinese: 「大王！
english: "Great King!

chinese: 譬如父母憐愍於子，心常欲令離苦得樂；王亦應爾，於諸國邑所有眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，應以諸佛所說四攝而受之。
english: Just as parents have compassion for their children, their hearts always wishing them to escape suffering and attain happiness, so too should a king act thus: toward all sentient beings in the various kingdoms and cities, servants, workers, ministers, and officials, he should receive them using the four means of gathering that the Buddhas have taught.

chinese: 何等為四？
english: What are the four?

chinese: 一者、布施；二者、愛語；三者、利行；四者、同事。
english: First, generosity; second, kind speech; third, beneficial conduct; fourth, working together.

chinese: 如是善攝國邑眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，攝於二義同事同歸。
english: Thus he skillfully governs the people of the country and its cities, the servants, workers, ministers, and officials, uniting them through two principles so they work together and share the same purpose.

chinese: 何等二義？
english: What are the two meanings?

chinese: 一者、現在；二者、未來。
english: One is the present; two is the future.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 譬如男子或諸女人，於其夢中夢心所見，可愛園林可愛山谷，可愛國邑并諸異類，彼夢覺已所見皆無。
english: Just as when a man or woman, in their dreams, sees in their dreaming mind lovely gardens, lovely valleys, lovely cities and various other things, when they awaken from the dream, all that they saw is gone.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命虛偽無常，一切皆如夢之所見。
english: The nation's fate and one's life are illusory and impermanent; all things are like what is seen in a dream.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步諸軍宮殿，后妃太子諸王，輔臣僚佐防衛士眾，父母兄弟姊妹妻妾，男女大小僮僕作使國邑眾生，金銀珍寶末尼真珠，衣服財穀庫藏等物，如是所有諸欲樂具，於命終時皆當棄捨，獨往後世無一相隨。
english: The pleasures of royal wealth, the pleasures of royal freedom, the pleasures of royal desires, and all other instruments of sensual pleasure—namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, armies, palaces, queens, consorts, crown princes, princes, ministers, officials, guards, parents, brothers, sisters, wives, concubines, men and women both old and young, servants, subjects of the kingdom, gold, silver, precious treasures, mani jewels, pearls, clothing, wealth, grain, storehouses and such things—all these instruments of sensual pleasure must be abandoned at the time of death. One goes alone to the next world, with not a single thing following along.

chinese: 「大王知！
english: "Your Majesty, know this!"

chinese: 如上所說一切樂具，非常非恒不可保信，皆變易法迅速不停，流轉移動終歸壞滅，念念遷謝後為灰燼，究竟同趣滅盡之門，是失壞法有諸怖畏、有諸災橫、多諸愁惱，皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之。
english: All pleasurable things as described above are impermanent, not eternal, and cannot be relied upon. They are all subject to change, swiftly and ceaselessly transforming, flowing and moving until they finally decay and perish. Moment by moment they deteriorate and eventually turn to ashes, ultimately all heading toward the gate of complete extinction. These are phenomena of loss and decay, fraught with various fears and calamities, filled with much sorrow and affliction - all are things that fall, decline, break apart, and scatter.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 譬如樹林先見開華，尋復結果後還無果，先見其葉榮茂青翠，尋復萎黃後皆凋落。
english: Just as in a forest one first sees flowers bloom, then fruit forms, and later the fruit disappears; first one sees leaves flourishing lush and green, then they turn yellow and wither, and finally all fall away.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The nation's destiny and one's life, the king's wealth and noble pleasures, the king's sovereign pleasures, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other implements of sensual pleasure - namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, armies and so forth, extensively speaking - all are likewise dharmas of falling, scattering, breaking, and dispersing.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!"

chinese: 如大火聚，先見熾然復極熾然，轉遍熾然後皆洞然，雖久熾盛終歸滅盡。
english: Like a great mass of fire, first seen blazing, then blazing extremely, then blazing all around, afterwards completely aflame—though it burns fiercely for a long time, in the end it will be entirely extinguished.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The longevity of the nation and one's life, the king's wealth and pleasures, the king's pleasures of freedom, the king's pleasures of desires, and all other instruments of sensual pleasures - namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, and armies, and so forth in detail - all these are likewise dharmas subject to decline, falling away, destruction, and dispersal.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如日月輪，有大神用具大勢力，放大光明以自莊嚴，遍照世間終歸隱沒。
english: Like the sun and moon discs, possessing great divine power and endowed with great might, radiating great light to adorn themselves, illuminating the entire world before ultimately disappearing into obscurity.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The destiny of the nation and one's own life, the king's wealth and noble pleasures, the king's pleasures of freedom, the king's pleasures of love and desire, and all other instruments of sensual pleasure - namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, armies and so forth - speaking extensively, all these are likewise dharmas of falling, decline, deterioration, breaking apart, and dispersal.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如大雲遍覆虛空，暴風疾雷掣電注雨，震動天地須臾散滅。
english: Like a great cloud that completely covers the empty sky, with violent winds, rapid thunder, lightning flashes, and pouring rain, shaking heaven and earth, yet dispersing and vanishing in an instant.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The nation's destiny and lifespan, the king's wealth and noble pleasures, the king's sovereign pleasures, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other implements of desire and pleasure - namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, armies and so forth, speaking broadly up to all things - are likewise subject to the dharma of falling, withering, breaking apart, and scattering.

chinese: 是故，大王！
english: Therefore, Great King!

chinese: 應善勤修，隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀，於自命終常當驚懼，為大國王應以正法勿以非法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: One should diligently practice, following the contemplation of impermanence and the contemplation of extinction. Always be vigilant about one's own death. As a great king, you should rule with righteous law, not with unrighteous law. You should act in accordance with the Dharma, not against the Dharma.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如四大山從四方來，牢固堅密無有缺漏無諸間隙，周匝充遍總一合成，上盡虛空下窮地際，其中所有一切草木枝條花葉，及諸有情蠢動之類皆被磨滅，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而可禁止。
english: Like four great mountains coming from the four directions, firm and solid, dense without any gaps or cracks, without any spaces between them, completely surrounding and merging into one, reaching up to the limits of empty space and down to the depths of the earth - all the grasses, trees, branches, flowers and leaves within, as well as all sentient beings and crawling creatures, would be crushed and destroyed. This could not be escaped through determination or courage, could not be resisted through force or power, could not be prevented through spells, wealth, goods, or medicines.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 世有四種大怖畏事，各來磨滅一切眾生，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而能禁止。
english: There are four types of great fearsome matters in the world, each coming to destroy all living beings. They cannot be escaped through determination or courage, cannot be resisted through power or force, and cannot be prevented through spells, wealth, goods, or medicines.

chinese: 「云何四種大怖畏事？
english: "What are the four types of great fearful matters?"

chinese: 大王當知！
english: Great King, you should know!

chinese: 一者、老來逼害，磨滅眾生少壯；二者、病來逼害，磨滅眾生調適；三者、死來逼害，磨滅眾生壽命；四者、衰來逼害，磨滅眾生興盛。
english: First, old age oppresses and harms, eroding the youth and vigor of sentient beings; second, illness oppresses and harms, eroding the well-being of sentient beings; third, death oppresses and harms, eroding the lifespan of sentient beings; fourth, decline oppresses and harms, eroding the prosperity of sentient beings.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 譬如師子為眾獸王，入鹿群中搏取一鹿，若噉未噉自在無難。
english: Just as the lion, being the king of beasts, enters a herd of deer and seizes one deer, whether it eats it or not, it remains free and untroubled.

chinese: 其鹿爾時先所騰勇，入師子口無復能為。
english: The deer at that time, though previously spirited and brave, upon entering the lion's mouth could no longer do anything.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生既入無常師子王口，所有勢力無復能為。
english: All sentient beings, having entered the mouth of the lion king of impermanence, have no power left to act.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 譬如有人勇健多力毒箭所中，一切威猛皆悉摧滅。
english: Just as when a person of great courage and strength is struck by a poisoned arrow, all their might and power are completely destroyed.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生剛強戾，死箭所中無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦渴所逼張口大息，手足紛亂無所堪能，無有勢力涎涕交流，大小便利穢污身體，六根閉塞喉喘息急，良醫拱手棄諸妙藥。
english: All sentient beings are stubborn and violent. Struck by the arrow of death, they have no more strength, no more protection, no refuge, no place to flee. When about to abandon life and their joints come apart, their blood and flesh dry up, their hearts and chests burn with anguish. Oppressed by scorching thirst, they open their mouths wide and breathe heavily. Their hands and feet move chaotically, unable to do anything, having no strength. Saliva and mucus flow together, urine and feces defile their bodies. The six sense organs are blocked, the throat gasps for urgent breath. Even skilled physicians stand with folded hands, abandoning all wonderful medicines.

chinese: 其所飲噉美味珍饌無不悉捨，偃臥床枕臨往異趣淪沒無際，生老病死無常流，至臨終位餘命無幾，業有力故後有現前。
english: The delicious foods and precious delicacies they consume must all be abandoned. Lying on their beds and pillows, approaching different destinies, they sink into the boundless. The impermanent flow of birth, aging, sickness, and death arrives at the final moment when little life remains. Due to the power of karma, the next existence manifests before them.

chinese: 甚大怖畏琰魔王使，廣大黑闇夜分所吞，出息入息最後將滅，唯獨一身無有第二及餘伴侶，奄背此生歸於後世。
english: When the terrifying messengers of King Yama come, swallowed by the vast darkness of the night, with the final breath about to cease, utterly alone without a second person or any other companion, one turns away from this life and goes to the next world.

chinese: 是大移轉趣大叢林，入大黑闇遊大曠野，泛大溟海業風所飄，往無標記冥方所，當於爾時無異救護、無異歸依、無異投竄，唯除正法。
english: This is the great migration toward the great forest, entering the great darkness, wandering the great wilderness, drifting on the great ocean sea blown by the winds of karma, going to unmarked and dark regions. At that time, there will be no other salvation, no other refuge, no other place to flee to, except the true Dharma.

chinese: 大王！
english: Your Majesty!

chinese: 彼於爾時，唯有正法能為救、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: At that time, only the true Dharma can serve as salvation, can serve as a palace hall, can serve as refuge - it is what one hastens toward, it is where one flees to for shelter, able to extract sentient beings from the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如有人寒苦所逼，有煖火日光衣等，所能止息而可獲安；熱苦所逼林泉等；若涉遠道清涼陰；若渴所逼清冷水；若飢所逼多美膳，若病所逼惟良醫藥及供侍者；若怖所逼惟強伴侶。
english: Just as when someone is oppressed by cold suffering, there are warm fires, sunlight, clothing and such that can cease it and bring peace; when oppressed by heat suffering, there are forests and springs; when traveling far roads, there is cool shade; when oppressed by thirst, there is clear cold water; when oppressed by hunger, there is abundant fine food; when oppressed by illness, there are only good medicines and attendants; when oppressed by fear, there are only strong companions.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus it is, Great King!

chinese: 一切眾生死箭所中，無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦所逼張口，手足紛亂無所堪能，廣說乃至彼於爾時唯有正法，能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: All sentient beings are struck by the arrow of death, having no more strength, no more protection, no place of refuge, no place to flee. When they are about to give up their lives and their joints come apart, their blood and flesh dry up, their hearts and chests burn with anguish, scorched and oppressed they open their mouths, their hands and feet move chaotically without any ability to endure. To speak extensively—at that time, only the true Dharma can serve as protection, can serve as a palace, can be a refuge, is the place to run to, is the place to take shelter, and can extract sentient beings from the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖加守護雖久洗飾，雖以眾多上妙飲食恣意飽滿，及至臨終，要當不免飢渴所逼而便捨命。
english: This body, even if carefully protected, even if washed and adorned for a long time, even if satisfied at will with numerous supreme foods and drinks, when the time of death arrives, will inevitably be oppressed by hunger and thirst and thus abandon life.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖常澡浴，塗香末香香花鬘隨意嚴飾，由此自體穢漏成故，臨捨命時，終必歸於不淨臭穢。
english: Such is this body: though constantly bathed and perfumed, adorned at will with fragrant powders, flower garlands and ornaments, because it is by nature composed of foul secretions, when the time comes to abandon life, it must inevitably return to impurity, foulness and stench.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖以種種上妙衣服覆蔽纏裹，由此自身諸不淨物所合成故，於命終時，要當不淨種種流出。
english: Thus this body, though covered and wrapped with various fine garments, because it is composed of impure substances, at the time of death will inevitably discharge various impurities.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室后妃婇女內美人眷屬圍遶，作眾伎樂種種倡，以自娛樂歡喜快樂，臨命終時，自見惡相，要當驚怖憂悲苦惱。
english: Such a body, though dwelling in palace chambers surrounded by queens, concubines, consorts, and beautiful attendants, enjoying various musical performances and entertainments, delighting in pleasures and happiness - when the time of death approaches, it will see evil omens and inevitably experience terror, sorrow, grief, and suffering.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室綵飾畫殿閣樓臺，戶牖軒窓重密掩，種種香花以自嚴飾，種種燈燭光照明，施設珍奇屏障帷幄，燒眾名香散諸妙花，香花寶瓶處處陳列，安置種種金銀琉璃眾寶床座，敷設上妙氍錦繡文蓐花氈，床座兩頭俱置丹枕，覆以上妙綺帊錦衾，寤寐安寢歡娛耽著，於命終後無所覺知，或屍骸置於葬所，烏鵲鵰鷲狐狼野干，餓狗鵄梟諸惡禽獸爭共食噉，骨肉膿血鬚髮糞穢，流溢地上臭處可惡。
english: Such is this body—though it may dwell in palaces with colorful decorations, painted halls, towers and pavilions, with doors, windows, and lattices heavily sealed, adorned with various fragrant flowers, illuminated by various lamps and candles, furnished with precious screens and curtains, burning fine incense and scattering wondrous flowers, with fragrant flower-filled precious vases displayed everywhere, equipped with various beds and seats of gold, silver, lapis lazuli and other treasures, spread with superior rugs, brocades, embroidered mats and flower-patterned felts, with vermillion pillows placed at both ends of the beds, covered with fine silk canopies and brocade quilts, enjoying sleep and rest in pleasure and attachment—after death it knows nothing. When the corpse is placed at the burial ground, crows, magpies, vultures, foxes, wolves, jackals, hungry dogs, owls, and various evil birds and beasts compete to devour it. Bones, flesh, pus, blood, hair, and filth flow and spread upon the ground, creating a foul and repulsive stench.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 爾時，世尊告文殊師利菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Manjushri Bodhisattva: "Excellent!"

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩諮詢如來因地法行，及為末世一切眾生求大乘者，得正住持不墮邪見。
english: You are able to inquire on behalf of all bodhisattvas about the Tathagata's causal ground practices, and for all sentient beings in the final age who seek the Great Vehicle, enabling them to attain correct abiding and upholding without falling into wrong views.

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I shall explain it to you.

chinese: 」時，文殊師利菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Manjushri Bodhisattva received the teaching with joy, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!"

chinese: 無上法王有大陀羅尼門，名為圓覺，流出一切清淨真如菩提涅槃及教授菩薩。
english: The Supreme Dharma King has a great dhāraṇī gate called Perfect Enlightenment, from which flows forth all pure suchness, bodhi, nirvana, and the teachings for bodhisattvas.

chinese: 一切如來本起因地，皆依圓照清淨覺相，永斷無明方成佛道。
english: All Tathagatas, from their original causal ground, rely on the perfectly illuminating pure characteristic of enlightenment, and only by forever severing ignorance do they accomplish the Buddha Way.

chinese: 云何無明？
english: What is ignorance?

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good sons!

chinese: 一切眾生從無始來種種顛倒，猶如迷人四方易處，妄認四大為自身相，六塵緣影為自心相；譬彼病目見空中花及第二月。
english: All sentient beings, from beginningless time, have been subject to various delusions. Like a confused person who mistakes the four directions, they falsely take the four great elements to be their own bodily form and the shadows of the six sense objects to be their own mind. This is like someone with diseased eyes seeing flowers in the sky or a second moon.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 空實無花，病者妄執。
english: Empty reality has no flowers; the sick person falsely grasps them.

chinese: 由妄執故，非唯惑此虛空自性，亦復迷彼實花生處，由此妄有輪轉生死，故名無明。
english: Due to deluded attachment, not only is the true nature of empty space misunderstood, but also the actual source of the flowers is confused. Because of this delusion, there is the cycle of birth and death, therefore it is called ignorance.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 此無明者非實有體，如夢中人夢時非無，及至於醒了無所得；如眾空花滅於虛空，不可說言有定滅處，何以故？
english: This ignorance has no real substance. Like a person in a dream who is not non-existent while dreaming, yet when awakened there is nothing to be found; like myriad sky-flowers vanishing into empty space, one cannot say there is a definite place where they cease to exist. Why is this so?

chinese: 無生處故。
english: Because there is no place of birth.

chinese: 一切眾生於無生中，妄見生滅，是故說名輪轉生死。
english: All sentient beings, within the unborn, falsely perceive birth and death, and for this reason are said to revolve in the cycle of birth and death.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 如來因地修圓覺者，知是空花，即無輪轉，亦無身心受彼生死，非作故無，本性無故。
english: When the Tathagata cultivates perfect enlightenment from the causal ground, knowing that these are empty flowers, there is then no cycle of transmigration, nor are there body and mind that undergo birth and death. This is not because of deliberate action that they don't exist, but because they are fundamentally without existence by their original nature.

chinese: 彼知覺者猶如虛空，知虛空者即空花相，亦不可說無知覺性。
english: That which knows and perceives is just like empty space; that which knows empty space is merely the appearance of flowers in the sky, yet one cannot say it lacks the nature of knowing and perceiving.

chinese: 有、無俱遣，是名為淨覺隨順。
english: Having and non-having are both dismissed - this is called pure awakening in accordance.

chinese: 何以故？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 虛空性故，常不動故，如來藏中無起滅故，無知見故，如法界性究竟圓滿遍十方故；是則名為因地法行。
english: Because it is of the nature of empty space, because it is eternally unmoving, because within the Tathagata-garbha there is no arising or ceasing, because there is no knowing or seeing, because it is of the nature of the dharma-realm, ultimately perfect and complete, pervading the ten directions—this is what is called the causal ground of dharma practice.

chinese: 菩薩因此於大乘中發清淨心，末世眾生依此修行不墮邪見。
english: The bodhisattva thus generates a pure mind in the Great Vehicle. Sentient beings of the degenerate age who practice according to this will not fall into wrong views.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「文殊汝當知，一切諸如來，從於本因地，皆以智慧覺，了達於無明。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to reiterate this meaning, spoke in verse: "Manjusri, you should know that all Tathagatas, from their original causal ground, have all through the enlightenment of wisdom comprehended ignorance.

chinese: 知彼如空花，即能免流轉，又如夢中人，醒時不可得。
english: Knowing that they are like flowers in the sky, one can thus avoid the cycle of transmigration. They are also like people in a dream - when awakened, they cannot be found.

chinese: 覺者如虛空，平等不動轉，覺遍十方界，即得成佛道。
english:
The awakened one is like empty space,
Equal and unmoving,
When awakening pervades the worlds in all ten directions,
One immediately attains the Buddha way.

chinese: 眾幻滅無處，成道亦無得，本性圓滿故。
english:
All illusions cease without abode,
Attaining the Way, there is also nothing gained,
Because original nature is already perfect and complete.

chinese: 菩薩於此中，能發菩提心，末世諸眾生，修此免邪見。
english:
The Bodhisattva, within this,
Can generate the mind of enlightenment.
Sentient beings of the final age,
By practicing this, avoid wrong views.

chinese: 」於是普賢菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, in the midst of the great assembly, immediately rose from his seat, bowed his head to the Buddha's feet, circumambulated three times to the right, knelt with palms joined and addressed the Buddha, saying: "Great Compassionate World-Honored One!"

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾，及為末世一切眾生修大乘者，聞此圓覺清淨境界，云何修行？
english: I wish to ask for the sake of all the bodhisattvas in this assembly, and for all sentient beings in the final age who practice the Great Vehicle, having heard of this perfect enlightenment and pure realm, how should they cultivate?

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若彼眾生，知如幻者，身心亦幻，云何以幻還修於幻？
english: If those sentient beings know that all is illusory, and that body and mind are also illusions, how can they use illusion to cultivate illusion?

chinese: 若諸幻性，一切盡滅，無有心，誰為修行？
english: If all illusory natures were completely extinguished and there was no mind, who would practice cultivation?

chinese: 云何復說修行如幻？
english: How can one further explain that cultivation is like an illusion?

chinese: 若諸眾生本不修行，於生死中常居幻化，曾不了知如幻境界，令妄想心云何解脫？
english: If sentient beings fundamentally do not cultivate, constantly dwelling in illusion within birth and death, having never understood the illusory realm, how can their deluded minds attain liberation?

chinese: 願為末世一切眾生，作何方便漸次修習，令諸眾生永離諸幻。
english: I wish to create skillful means for all sentient beings in the final age to gradually cultivate and practice, so that all sentient beings may forever transcend all illusions.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: Having spoken these words, he prostrated himself with all five parts of his body touching the ground, making this request three times from beginning to end.

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普賢菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Bodhisattva Samantabhadra: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，修習菩薩如幻三昧，方便漸次，令諸眾生得離諸幻。
english: You all are able to help the bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age cultivate the bodhisattva's illusory samadhi, with skillful means and gradual stages, enabling all sentient beings to become free from all illusions.

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I shall explain it to you.

chinese: 」時，普賢菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva received the teaching with joy, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!

chinese: 一切眾生種種幻化，皆生如來圓覺妙心，猶如空花從空而有，幻花雖滅空性不壞；眾生幻心還依幻滅，諸幻盡滅覺心不動。
english: All sentient beings' various illusory transformations arise from the Tathagata's perfect enlightenment wondrous mind, just as sky-flowers appear from emptiness. Though the illusory flowers perish, the nature of emptiness is not destroyed; sentient beings' illusory minds likewise depend on illusion for their cessation. When all illusions are completely extinguished, the enlightened mind remains unmoved.

chinese: 依幻說覺亦名為幻，若說有覺猶未離幻，說無覺者亦復如是。
english: Relying on illusion to speak of enlightenment, this too is called illusion. If one speaks of having enlightenment, one has still not departed from illusion. Speaking of no enlightenment is also like this.

chinese: 是故，幻滅名為不動。
english: Therefore, the cessation of illusion is called the unmoved.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生，應當遠離一切幻化虛妄境界，堅執持遠離心故，心如幻者亦復遠離，遠離為幻亦復遠離，離遠離幻亦復遠離，得無所離即除諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age should distance themselves from all illusory and false realms. By firmly maintaining this mind of detachment, even the mind that is like an illusion should also be detached from. The detachment itself being illusory should also be detached from. Being detached from the illusion of detachment should also be detached from. When there is nothing left to detach from, all illusions are eliminated.

chinese: 譬如鑽火兩木相因，火出木盡灰飛煙滅；以幻修幻亦復如是，諸幻雖盡不入斷滅。
english: Just as when drilling for fire, two pieces of wood depend on each other—when fire emerges, the wood is consumed, ashes fly away, and smoke vanishes; using illusion to cultivate illusion is also like this—though all illusions are exhausted, one does not enter into annihilation.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 知幻即離，不作方便；離幻即覺，亦無漸次。
english: Knowing illusion is itself separation from it, without needing expedient means; being free from illusion is itself awakening, also without gradual stages.

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生依此修行，如是乃能永離諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the degenerate age who practice according to this will thus be able to forever transcend all illusions.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「普賢汝當知，一切諸眾生，無始幻無明，皆從諸如來，圓覺心建立。
english:
At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to proclaim this meaning again, spoke in verse:

"Samantabhadra, you should know,
All sentient beings,
With beginningless illusory ignorance,
All arise from the Tathagatas'
Perfect enlightenment mind established.

chinese: 猶如虛空花，依空而有相，空花若復滅，虛空本不動。
english:
Just like flowers in the sky,
Depending on emptiness to have form,
If the sky flowers were to vanish,
Empty space itself remains unmoved.

chinese: 幻從諸覺生，幻滅覺圓滿，覺心不動故。
english: Illusions arise from various perceptions; when illusions cease, awakening is perfected, because the awakened mind remains unmoved.

chinese: 若彼諸菩薩，及末世眾生，常應遠離幻，諸幻悉皆離。
english: If those bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age constantly remain far from illusion, all illusions will be completely abandoned.

chinese: 如木中生火，木盡火還滅，覺無漸次，方便亦如是。
english: Like fire arising from wood—when the wood is exhausted, the fire also extinguishes. Awakening has no gradual stages; skillful means are also like this.

chinese: 」於是普眼菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then Universal Eye Bodhisattva rose from his seat in the great assembly, prostrated at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated him three times to the right, knelt with palms joined and addressed the Buddha, saying: "O Greatly Compassionate World-Honored One!"

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾及為末世一切眾生，演說菩薩修行漸次，云何思惟？
english: May you, for the sake of all the bodhisattvas in this assembly and for all sentient beings in the final age, expound the gradual stages of bodhisattva practice. How should they contemplate?

chinese: 云何住持？
english: How does one abide and maintain?

chinese: 眾生未悟作何方便普令開悟？
english: How can we employ skillful means to universally awaken all sentient beings who have not yet attained enlightenment?

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若彼眾生無正方便及正思惟，聞佛如來說此三昧心生迷悶，於圓覺不能悟入。
english: If those sentient beings lack correct methods and correct contemplation, when they hear the Buddha Tathagata explain this samadhi, confusion and bewilderment arise in their minds, and they are unable to awaken to and enter perfect enlightenment.

chinese: 願興慈悲，為我等輩及末世眾生假說方便。
english: May you raise compassion and expound expedient means for us and for sentient beings of the final age.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: Having spoken these words, he prostrated himself with all five parts of his body touching the ground, making this request three times from beginning to end.

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普眼菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Universal Vision Bodhisattva: "Excellent!"

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，問於如來修行漸次、思惟、住持乃至假說種種方便，汝今諦聽！
english: You are all able to ask the Tathagata on behalf of the bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age about the gradual stages of cultivation, contemplation, sustained practice, and even the various expedient means that are provisionally taught. Now listen carefully!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: I shall explain it to you.

chinese: 」時，普眼菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Universal Vision Bodhisattva received the teaching with joy, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!"

chinese: 彼新學菩薩及末世眾生，欲求如來淨圓覺心，應當正念遠離諸幻，先依如來奢摩他行，堅持禁戒，安處徒眾，宴坐室，作是念：『我今此身四大和合，所謂髮毛、爪齒、皮肉、筋骨、髓腦、垢色皆歸於地，唾涕、膿血、津液、涎沫、痰淚、精氣、大小便利皆歸於水，暖氣歸火，動轉歸風。
english: Those newly learning bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age who wish to seek the Tathagata's pure and perfect enlightened mind should maintain right mindfulness and distance themselves from all illusions. First, they should rely on the Tathagata's practice of shamatha, firmly uphold the prohibitive precepts, peacefully dwell among the assembly of disciples, sit quietly in meditation halls, and contemplate thus: 'This body of mine is now a combination of the four great elements. That which is called hair, body hair, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, marrow, brain, and all impure matter return to earth. Saliva, mucus, pus, blood, fluids, drool, phlegm, tears, vital essence, and all excretions return to water. Warmth returns to fire, and movement returns to wind.'

chinese: 四大各離，今者妄身當在何處？
english: The four great elements each separate—where then does this illusory body exist now?

chinese: 其樹有種種葉，如真多摩尼。
english: Its trees have various kinds of leaves, like true mani jewels.

chinese: 樹形於上繫種種繒綵，或繫吠瑠璃寶天菓妙衣，或垂雲降雨。
english: Tree-like forms above are adorned with various silk ribbons and colored fabrics, or hung with vaidurya jewels, heavenly fruits, and wondrous garments, or they send down clouds and rain.

chinese: 有種種芽，吉祥眾鳥並坐其上。
english: There are various kinds of sprouts, and auspicious birds perch upon them together.

chinese: 或於枝間種種寶葉已成劫樹，世尊兩肩後倚著其樹。
english: On branches there are various precious leaves that have already become kalpa trees, and the World-Honored One leans back against these trees with both shoulders.

chinese: 佛右邊座下畫轉輪王形，坐白蓮華，作觀佛勢。
english: On the right side below the Buddha is painted the figure of a Wheel-Turning King, sitting on a white lotus flower, in a posture of contemplating the Buddha.

chinese: 其身金色，周遍光明，七寶成就，惟輪寶以光圍繞在蓮華上。
english: His body is golden in color, radiating light all around. The seven treasures are fully manifested, with only the wheel treasure surrounded by light resting upon the lotus flower.

chinese: 餘六寶如次安之。
english: The remaining six treasures are placed in sequence.

chinese: 東南角摧碎佛頂南勝佛頂西南角無邊聲佛頂西白傘蓋佛頂西北角高廣佛頂北光聚佛頂東北角最勝佛頂正東高佛頂已上中院。
english: Southeast corner: Crushing Buddha Crown. South: Victorious Buddha Crown. Southwest corner: Boundless Voice Buddha Crown. West: White Parasol Buddha Crown. Northwest corner: High and Vast Buddha Crown. North: Light Gathering Buddha Crown. Northeast corner: Most Victorious Buddha Crown. Due East: High Buddha Crown. The above are in the middle court.

chinese: 次第二院獨古杵界道。
english: Secondly, the Dokko (Vajra) Realm Path of the Second Court.

chinese: 東南角法波羅蜜菩薩次大勢至觀音菩薩葉衣觀音菩薩多羅觀音菩薩觀世音菩薩毘俱胝觀音菩薩白衣觀音菩薩觀自在王菩薩西南角羯磨波羅蜜菩薩次禪波羅蜜菩薩忍波羅蜜菩薩施波羅蜜菩薩虛空明妃戒波羅蜜菩薩精進波羅蜜菩薩惠波羅蜜菩薩西北角金剛波羅蜜菩薩次降三世金剛菩薩金剛將明妃金剛將童子金剛手菩薩金剛母菩薩蘇婆呼童子菩薩頂行童子菩薩同前東北角寶波羅蜜菩薩次般若波羅蜜菩薩慈氏菩薩佛慈菩薩佛眼菩薩佛豪相菩薩文殊菩薩如意寶菩薩已上第二院。
english: In the southeast corner, Dharma Perfection Bodhisattva, followed by Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Leaf-Robe Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Tara Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Bhrikuti Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, White-Robed Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteshvara King Bodhisattva. In the southwest corner, Karma Perfection Bodhisattva, followed by Meditation Perfection Bodhisattva, Patience Perfection Bodhisattva, Giving Perfection Bodhisattva, Space Radiance Consort, Precepts Perfection Bodhisattva, Diligence Perfection Bodhisattva, Wisdom Perfection Bodhisattva. In the northwest corner, Vajra Perfection Bodhisattva, followed by Trailokyavijaya Vajra Bodhisattva, Vajra General Consort, Vajra General Youth, Vajrapani Bodhisattva, Vajra Mother Bodhisattva, Subahu Youth Bodhisattva, Crown-Practice Youth Bodhisattva, same as before. In the northeast corner, Jewel Perfection Bodhisattva, followed by Prajna Paramita Bodhisattva, Maitreya Bodhisattva, Buddha Compassion Bodhisattva, Buddha Eye Bodhisattva, Buddha Urna Bodhisattva, Manjushri Bodhisattva, Wish-Fulfilling Jewel Bodhisattva. The above constitutes the second court.

chinese: 次第三院同第二界道。
english: Each of the third court is the same as the second realm path.

chinese: 東南角歌供養菩薩次如意輪菩薩纔發心轉法輪菩薩八聖觀音菩薩蓮華吉祥菩薩蓮華孫陀利菩薩青頸觀音菩薩蓮華髻菩薩蓮華藥叉菩薩十一面觀音菩薩西南角舞供養菩薩次嚩哩迦龍王嚩哩迦七頭阿難陀龍王無染河天者地天供養無能勝姤菩薩無能勝妃無熱惱龍王目真鱗龍王龍女西北角獻喜菩薩次烏芻瑟摩金剛金剛藏菩薩甘露軍吒利菩薩金剛孫陀利菩薩金剛愛菩薩金剛拳菩薩施無畏菩薩鉢拏攝末里菩薩金剛針菩薩東北角鬘供養菩薩談無竭菩薩陀羅尼自在菩薩摩麼鷄菩薩大惠菩薩寂靜菩薩無垢惠菩薩虛空無垢菩薩海惠菩薩善象猛菩薩已上第三院。
english: In the southeast corner, the Song Offering Bodhisattva, followed by Cintamanicakra Bodhisattva, Just-Initiated-Mind-Turning-the-Dharma-Wheel Bodhisattva, Eight Sacred Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, Lotus Auspicious Bodhisattva, Lotus Sundari Bodhisattva, Blue-Necked Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, Lotus Topknot Bodhisattva, Lotus Yaksha Bodhisattva, and Eleven-Faced Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. In the southwest corner, the Dance Offering Bodhisattva, followed by Varuna Dragon King, Seven-Headed Varuna, Ananda Dragon King, Undefiled River Deva, Earth Deva Offering, Invincible Bodhisattva, Invincible Consort, Anavatapta Dragon King, Manasvin Dragon King, and Dragon Princess. In the northwest corner, the Joy-Offering Bodhisattva, followed by Ucchusma Vajra, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva, Amrita Gundali Bodhisattva, Vajra Sundari Bodhisattva, Vajra Love Bodhisattva, Vajra Fist Bodhisattva, Bestowing Fearlessness Bodhisattva, Bowl-Grasping Samari Bodhisattva, and Vajra Needle Bodhisattva. In the northeast corner, the Garland Offering Bodhisattva, Amoghavajra Bodhisattva, Dharani Self-Mastery Bodhisattva, Mamaki Bodhisattva, Great Wisdom Bodhisattva, Tranquil Bodhisattva, Undefiled Wisdom Bodhisattva, Space Undefiled Bodhisattva, Ocean Wisdom Bodhisattva, and Good Elephant Fierce Bodhisattva. The above constitutes the Third Court.

chinese: 金剛界外第四院辦事天等次第外供養從東南角燈供養菩薩次火天姤焰魔天王當門金剛鈴菩薩次焰魔王姤羅剎天主西南角塗香菩薩次羅剎主姤毘沙門天王當門金剛鉤菩薩次毘沙門天姤風天主西北角香供養菩薩風天姤水天王當門金剛索菩薩水天姤伊舍那天東北角花供養菩薩伊舍那天姤帝釋天王當門金剛鎖菩薩帝釋姤火天主已上第四院。
english: In the fourth outer court of the Diamond Realm, the order of deities and others conducting affairs: The outer offerings begin from the southeast corner with the Lamp Offering Bodhisattva, next the Fire Deity consort of Yama the King of Death, at the gate the Vajra Bell Bodhisattva, next King Yama consort of the Rakshasa Lord, at the southwest corner the Perfume Paste Bodhisattva, next the Rakshasa Lord consort of Vaishravana the Heavenly King, at the gate the Vajra Hook Bodhisattva, next Vaishravana consort of the Wind Deity Lord, at the northwest corner the Incense Offering Bodhisattva, the Wind Deity consort of the Water Heavenly King, at the gate the Vajra Rope Bodhisattva, the Water Deity consort of Ishana, at the northeast corner the Flower Offering Bodhisattva, Ishana consort of Indra the Heavenly King, at the gate the Vajra Lock Bodhisattva, Indra consort of the Fire Deity Lord. The above constitutes the fourth court.

chinese: 從此第五食道院，四角畫五古杵契，焰鬘威相成。
english: From this fifth dining hall, at the four corners paint the five ancient vajra mudras, with flaming garlands manifesting their fierce forms.

chinese: 已上曼荼羅輪王大灌頂儀軌中上壇聖者，都計一百二十二尊號。
english: The holy ones on the upper altar in the Great Abhiṣeka Ritual of the Maṇḍala Wheel King mentioned above total one hundred and twenty-two deities.

chinese: 阿闍梨與弟子灌頂，應於大曼荼羅側、對聖眾面前，別塗作曼荼羅。
english: The ācārya, when giving abhiṣeka to disciples, should create a separate maṇḍala by painting it at the side of the great maṇḍala, facing the holy assembly.

chinese: 以白粉參肘量，普於中畫蓮花。
english: With white powder mixed at the elbow measure, universally paint lotus flowers in the center.

chinese: 中台上畫師子座，令灌頂弟子花了者坐上，令一解法弟子持蓋及拂誦吉慶聲讚徐徐不絕。
english: On the central platform, draw a lion throne and have the initiation disciple, adorned with flowers, sit upon it. Have another disciple skilled in the dharma hold a parasol and whisk, continuously chanting auspicious verses of praise without pause.

chinese: 取中瓶水加持一百八遍。
english: Take the water from the middle bottle and recite blessings over it one hundred and eight times.

chinese: 教弟子結佛頂印安於頂上，然須吹擊鼓作諸音樂等。
english: Teaching disciples to form the Buddha's Crown mudra and place it on the crown of the head, then they must blow conch shells, beat drums, and make various kinds of music.

chinese: 我今依經說，輪王畫像法，近人具眾流，作法方可為，如經廣稱述，白疊須頓方，五肘或三肘。
english:
I now, relying on the scriptures, explain
The method for painting images of wheel-turning kings.
When approaching people who possess all the streams,
Only then can the dharma method be performed.
As the scriptures extensively proclaim,
White cloth must be perfectly square,
Five cubits or three cubits in size.

chinese: 畫聖者像，先從大海踊出須彌山王，四寶所成，於山上坐白蓮華，身白金色，正受入最勝王三摩地，結跏趺坐。
english: The image of the holy one is painted: First, from the great ocean emerges Mount Sumeru, the king of mountains, formed of four precious substances. Upon the mountain sits a white lotus flower, on which sits one with a body of white-gold color, entering into the samādhi of the Supreme King, seated in the lotus position.

chinese: 從一切身遍滿流出十二幅金輪熾盛光明。
english: From the entire body flows forth everywhere the blazing bright radiance of the twelve-spoked golden wheel.

chinese: 於上應畫山峯，其峯以種種寶成。
english: On top, one should paint mountain peaks, those peaks made of various treasures.

chinese: 聖者從頂流出種種光明，青黃赤白旋轉自在。
english: The sage emanates various lights from the crown - blue, yellow, red, and white - rotating freely.

chinese: 聖者右邊畫持誦人，手執香爐，觀如來面。
english: The person reciting mantras is depicted to the right of the sage, holding an incense burner in hand, gazing at the face of the Tathagata.

chinese: 下應畫蓮花池。
english: Below should be painted a lotus pond.

chinese: 畫二大明王，相如後說。
english: They painted two great radiant kings, their forms as described later.

chinese: 尊儀賀野仡哩嚩大明王，身如火色，忿怒形，鼻如猿猴，以蛇莊嚴，瓔珞臂釧膊釧，頭繫蓮華鬘，作瞻睹勢。
english: The Venerable Yiheye Jilipo Great Bright King has a body the color of fire, with a wrathful form, a nose like an ape or monkey, adorned with snakes, wearing necklaces, armlets, and bracelets, with lotus garlands tied around his head, assuming a watchful gaze.

chinese: 次無能勝忿怒王，身白色，四臂，頻眉面嗔。
english: The next is the Invincible King of Wrath, with white body, four arms, furrowed brows and an angry face.

chinese: 虎皮為裙，蟒蛇為耳璫，得叉迦龍王以為腰，縚婆蘇枳龍王以為神線，角絡被耽肚。
english: She wears a tiger skin as a skirt, pythons as earrings, the Takshaka dragon king as her waist belt, the Vasuki dragon king as her sacred thread, with a garland of skulls draped across her belly.

chinese: 身形稍短，以毒蛇莊嚴髻冠，口咬下唇，遍身火焰熾盛圓光，右上手持金剛杵，右下手作期尅勢，左上手持三古戟叉，左下手執鉞斧。
english: His body is somewhat short, adorned with a crown decorated with venomous snakes, biting his lower lip, surrounded by intensely blazing flames forming a circular halo. His upper right hand holds a vajra, his lower right hand makes a threatening gesture, his upper left hand holds a three-pronged trident, and his lower left hand grasps a battle-axe.

chinese: 正面作阿吒吒賀娑勢，從口火焰種種色相，右邊面作觀瞻勢，左邊面下看也，頭上面作觀大眾勢。
english: The front face makes the Aṭaṭa Hāsa gesture, with flames of various colors emanating from the mouth. The right face makes a gazing gesture, the left face looks downward, and the face on top of the head makes the gesture of observing the great assembly.

chinese: 於寶蓮華立也了。
english: Standing upon the precious lotus flower, it is done.

chinese: 已上二聖者於曼荼羅門外兩邊畫。
english: The above two holy ones are to be drawn on both sides outside the mandala gate.

chinese: 次觀本尊五支也。
english: Next, contemplate the five branches of the principal deity.

chinese: 阿尾囉吽欠阿字微字囉字吽字欠字。
english: A Vi Ra Hūṃ Khaṃ A Ja Vi Ja Ra Ja Hūṃ Ja Khaṃ Ja.

chinese: 五支先布已，次說瑜伽相：阿字真金色，普現金剛輪，加持於下體，說名瑜伽座。
english: The five limbs having been previously established, next the characteristics of yoga are explained: The syllable A, of true golden color, universally manifests the vajra wheel. Empowering the lower body, this is called the yoga seat.

chinese: 微字素月光，匪於霧聚中，加持於齊上，是名大悲海。
english: The subtle character elemental moonlight, not within the gathering mist, bestows blessings upon the assembly above - this is called the Ocean of Great Compassion.

chinese: 囉字初日暉，形赤在三角，加持於心位，稱為智火威。
english: The ra syllable is like the first light of dawn, red in form within a triangle. Applied to the heart position, it is called the Wisdom Fire's Majesty.

chinese: 吽字劫火焰，塗玄若風輪，加持白毫際，名為自在力。
english:
The HŪṂ syllable's kalpa-fire flames,
Applied to the dark like a wind-wheel,
Blessed upon the white tuft between the brows,
This is called the power of sovereignty.

chinese: 欠字由大空，含容一切色，加持於頂上，故號無等人。
english: The character "欠" arises from great emptiness, containing and embracing all forms, blessed upon the crown, therefore called the Incomparable Person.

chinese: 次五支從地水火風空配成及壇。
english: The five branches that follow are formed from earth, water, fire, wind, and space, along with the altar.

chinese: 阿字想座下，金剛座已成，色相如黃金，即戒義也。
english: Beneath the throne where the letter A is contemplated, the vajra seat is already accomplished, its appearance like yellow gold - this is the meaning of precepts.

chinese: 其壇相方，曼荼囉亦耳。
english: The altar is square in form, and is also a mandala.

chinese: 微字想於臍，色白慈悲水，即定義也。
english: Visualize the character "wei" at the navel, white in color, the water of compassion - this is the meaning of concentration.

chinese: 其壇相圓，外壇如滿月。
english: The altar's form is circular, the outer altar like the full moon.

chinese: 囉字想於心，其相色赤紅，為惠義也。
english: The RA syllable is visualized in the heart, its appearance is red in color, representing the meaning of wisdom.

chinese: 其壇三角形，外壇亦三角。
english: The altar is triangular in shape, and the outer altar is also triangular.

chinese: 吽字想眉間，色黑，為無礙風，即解脫義也，其壇想青形如半月，外壇相亦同。
english: The HŪṂ syllable is visualized between the eyebrows, black in color, representing the unobstructed wind, which is the meaning of liberation. Its altar is visualized as blue-green in the shape of a half-moon, and the outer altar's appearance is also the same.

chinese: 欠字安頂上，以成大空點，即解脫知見義也。
english: Placing the character 欠 (qian) on top forms the great empty dot, which is the meaning of the knowledge and vision of liberation.

chinese: 其壇如字義，空點無色相，能成諸事業，即是陀羅尼義也。
english: The mandala, as the meaning of the characters indicates, is empty and without form or appearance, yet can accomplish all activities - this is the meaning of dhāraṇī.

chinese: 唵速乞灑摩嚩日囉唵底瑟姹嚩日囉唵薩頗囉拏嚩日囉唵僧賀囉嚩日囉次說畫蘇婆呼童子身形眷屬。
english: Om sukṣma vajra om tiṣṭha vajra om spharaṇa vajra om saṃhara vajra. Next, explain the painted form and retinue of the Subāhu youth.

chinese: 尊身如童子形，金色如名號，悚慄畫尊儀，七曜圍繞。
english: The revered body takes the form of a youth, golden in color like the name suggests, depicted with an awe-inspiring appearance, surrounded by the seven celestial bodies.

chinese: 密莫雲漠、嗢沒斯、那纈鷄，各如本形畫，住賀野仡哩嚩明側，立花上。
english: Secret Mayūra, Cloud Desert, Udumbara, and Nāgakesara, each painted according to their original forms, dwelling beside the Hayagrīva deity, standing upon flowers.

chinese: 次畫頂行童子身形眷屬。
english: Next, paint at the top row the forms of the youth and his retinue.

chinese: 尊身金色，髻髮下垂，左手持金剛杵，右手叉腰，八頻那夜迦圍繞所為。
english: The honored body is golden in color, with hair hanging down from the topknot, holding a vajra in the left hand, right hand on the hip, surrounded by eight Vinayaka.

chinese: 金剛莊嚴、金剛塵、金剛索、金剛鉞斧、金剛極笑、金剛成莊嚴、金剛頂、金剛頻那夜，釰器仗如文配。
english: Vajra Splendor, Vajra Dust, Vajra Rope, Vajra Battle-axe, Vajra Supreme Laughter, Vajra Accomplished Splendor, Vajra Crown, Vajra Vinaya, with sword weapons arranged according to the text.

chinese: 已上並是頂輪壇法，具足寫了。
english: The above are all the crown wheel mandala methods, written in full.

chinese: 天喜元年五月一日書了一交了僧賴昭以天台實嚴僧正持本交合之東寺沙門道快此軌者弘和尚集歟？
english: Written on the first day of the fifth month of the first year of Tengi. Delivered to the monk Raishō. Compared with the original held by the Tendai monk Jitsugen Sōjō. Tōji monk Dōkai. Is this ritual manual a compilation by Kō Oshō?

chinese: 辨兩字通用之間。
english: Distinguishing between cases where two characters can be used interchangeably.

chinese: 青龍和尚門人制作，尤以可為規模者也。
english: The disciples of Master Qinglong produced this work, which can especially serve as a model.

chinese: 至明旦己，與諸眷屬持眾香華及諸妓樂至如來所，白言：「時至，願垂降臨。
english: When the next morning arrived, he went to where the Tathāgata was with his retinue, carrying various fragrances, flowers, and musical instruments, and said: "The time has come. Please graciously descend and visit."

chinese: 」爾時世尊軟語安慰彼婆羅門無垢妙光，遍告大眾，宣言：「汝等皆應往彼婆羅門家攝受供養，為欲令彼獲大利故。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One gently consoled the brahmin Vimalaprabha and proclaimed to the great assembly, saying: "You should all go to that brahmin's house to receive his offerings, so that he may obtain great benefit."

chinese: 」於時世尊即從座起，纔起座已從佛身出種種光明，間錯妙色照觸十方，悉皆警覺，然後趣道。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One immediately rose from his seat. As soon as he arose, various lights emanated from the Buddha's body, interwoven with wondrous colors, illuminating and touching the ten directions, awakening all beings, and then proceeded on the path.

chinese: 時婆羅門以恭敬心持妙香華，與諸眷屬及天龍八部、釋梵四王，先行治道，奉引如來。
english: At that time, the Brahmin, with a reverent heart, carrying wonderful incense and flowers, together with all his retinue, the eight classes of devas and nagas, Śakra, Brahmā, and the Four Heavenly Kings, went ahead to prepare the path and respectfully guided the Tathāgata.

chinese: 爾時世尊前路不遠，中至一園名曰豐財。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One had not traveled far along the road when he reached a garden called Abundant Wealth.

chinese: 於彼園中有古朽塔，摧壞崩倒荊棘掩庭、蔓草封戶瓦礫埋隱，狀若土堆。
english: In that garden there was an ancient, decaying pagoda, collapsed and fallen into ruin. Thorns and brambles covered the courtyard, creeping vines sealed the doorways, and tiles and rubble lay buried beneath, giving it the appearance of an earthen mound.

chinese: 爾時世尊逕往塔所。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One went directly to the stupa.

chinese: 于時塔上放大光明照耀熾盛，於土聚中出聲讚言：「善哉善哉！
english: At that time, the stupa emitted a great radiance, shining brilliantly and intensely. From within the mound of earth came a voice of praise, saying: "Excellent! Excellent!"

chinese: 釋迦牟尼！
english: Shakyamuni!

chinese: 今日所行極善境界。
english: Today's conduct has reached the utmost good state.

chinese: 又婆羅門！
english: Again, Brahmin!

chinese: 汝於今日獲大善利。
english: You have obtained great benefit and advantage today.

chinese: 」爾時世尊禮彼朽塔，右繞三迊，脫身上衣用覆其上，泫然垂淚涕血交流，泣已微笑。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One paid reverence to that dilapidated stupa, circumambulated it three times to the right, removed his upper garment to cover it, and with tears streaming down and blood mingling with his tears, after weeping, he smiled faintly.

chinese: 當爾之時，十方諸佛皆同觀視亦皆流淚，各所放光來照是塔。
english: At that time, all the Buddhas of the ten directions together gazed upon and also all shed tears, each emitting light that came to illuminate this stupa.

chinese: 于時大眾驚愕變色，互欲決疑。
english: At that time, the great assembly was shocked and changed color, each wanting to resolve their doubts.

chinese: 爾時金剛手菩薩等亦皆流淚，威焰熾盛執杵旋轉，往詣佛所，白言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva and the others also shed tears. With blazing majesty, wielding his vajra and spinning it, he approached the Buddha and said: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 此何因緣現是光相？
english: What causes and conditions manifest this light appearance?

chinese: 何如來眼流淚如是？
english: Why are your eyes flowing with tears like this?

chinese: 亦彼十方諸佛大瑞光相現前？
english: Do the great auspicious light signs of all the Buddhas in the ten directions also appear before you?

chinese: 唯願如來於此大眾解釋我疑。
english: I only wish that the Tathagata would resolve my doubts here before this great assembly.

chinese: 」時薄伽梵告金剛手：「此大全身舍利積聚如來寶塔，一切如來無量俱胝心陀羅尼密印法要今在其中。
english: At that time, the Bhagavān told Vajrapāṇi: "This great stupa of accumulated whole-body relics of the Tathāgata contains within it the dharani secret seal dharma essentials of the immeasurable koṭis of hearts of all Tathāgatas.

chinese: 金剛手！
english: Vajrapāṇi!

chinese: 有此法要在是中故，塔即變為重疊無隙如胡麻子俱胝百千如來之身。
english: Within this essential Dharma that exists here, the stupa immediately transforms into countless layers without gaps, like sesame seeds—hundreds of thousands of koṭis of Tathāgata bodies.

chinese: 當知亦是如胡麻子百千俱胝如來全身舍利之聚，乃至八萬四千法蘊亦在其中，九十九百千萬俱胝如來頂相亦在其中。
english: You should know that this is also like a collection of complete body relics of a hundred thousand kotis of Tathagatas the size of sesame seeds, and even the eighty-four thousand dharma aggregates are also contained within it, and the crown marks of ninety-nine hundred thousand myriad kotis of Tathagatas are also contained within it.

chinese: 由是妙事，是塔所在之處，有大神驗殊勝威德，能滿一切世間吉慶。
english: Due to these wondrous matters, wherever this stūpa is located, there are great spiritual efficacies and extraordinary majestic virtues, capable of fulfilling all auspicious blessings in the world.

chinese: 」爾時大眾聞佛是說，遠塵離垢斷諸煩惱，得法眼淨。
english: At that time, when the great assembly heard the Buddha speak thus, they removed dust and departed from defilement, severed all afflictions, and attained the purity of the Dharma eye.

chinese: 時眾機異利益亦別，須陀洹果、斯陀含果、阿那含果、阿羅漢果、辟支佛道，及菩薩道、阿鞞跋致、薩波若智，於如是事各得其一，或有證得初地二地乃至十地，或有滿足六波羅蜜。
english: At that time, the assembly had different capacities and thus received different benefits. Some attained the fruit of Stream-Entry, the fruit of Once-Returning, the fruit of Non-Returning, the fruit of Arhatship, or the path of Pratyekabuddha, as well as the Bodhisattva path, the stage of non-retrogression, and omniscient wisdom. Among these attainments, each person gained according to their capacity - some realized the first ground, the second ground, up to the tenth ground, while others perfected the six paramitas.

chinese: 其婆羅門遠塵離垢，得五神通。
english: The Brahmin transcended dust and defilement, and attained the five supernatural powers.

chinese: 時金剛手見此奇特希有之事，白言：「世尊！
english: Then Vajrapani, seeing this extraordinary and rare occurrence, said: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 妙哉奇異。
english: Wonderful and extraordinary!

chinese: 但聞此事尚獲如是殊勝功德，況聞深理至心起信得幾功德？
english: Just hearing about this matter already obtains such extraordinary merit and virtue - how much more merit and virtue does one gain from hearing the profound principle and giving rise to faith with utmost sincerity?

chinese: 」佛言：「諦聽。
english: The Buddha said: "Listen carefully."

chinese: 汝金剛手！
english: You, Vajrapāṇi!

chinese: 後世若有信男信女及復我等四部弟子，發心書寫此一經典，即准書寫九十九百千萬俱胝如來所說一切經典，即過於彼九十九百千萬俱胝如來之前久植善根，即亦彼諸一切如來加持護念猶如愛眼，亦如慈母愛護幼子。
english: In future ages, if there are faithful men and faithful women, as well as our four groups of disciples, who aspire to copy this single scripture, it will be equivalent to copying all the scriptures spoken by ninety-nine hundred thousand million koṭis of Tathāgatas. They will have planted good roots long ago before those ninety-nine hundred thousand million koṭis of Tathāgatas, and all those Tathāgatas will bless and protect them as they would cherish their own eyes, and as a compassionate mother protects her young child.

chinese: 若人讀誦此一卷經，即為讀誦過去現在未來諸佛所說經典。
english: If a person reads and recites this one volume of scripture, it is equivalent to reading and reciting all the scriptures spoken by the buddhas of the past, present, and future.

chinese: 由如是故，九十九百千萬俱胝一切如來應正等覺側塞無隙猶如胡麻重疊赴來，晝夜現身加持其人。
english: Because of this, ninety-nine hundred thousand million kotis of all Tathagatas, Arhats, and Samyak-sambuddhas crowd together without gaps like sesame seeds, piling up as they come, manifesting their bodies day and night to bless that person.

chinese: 如是一切諸佛如來無數恒沙，前聚未去後群重來，須臾推遷迴轉更赴，譬如細沙在水旋急，不得停滯迴去復來。
english: Thus all the Buddhas and Tathagatas, countless as the sands of the Ganges, with the previous gathering not yet departed and later groups arriving again, in an instant push forward and revolve in succession, like fine sand in swirling water that cannot remain still but circles away and returns again.

chinese: 若有人以香華塗香、華鬘衣服、微妙嚴具供養此經，即成於彼十方九十九百千萬俱胝如來之前，以天香華、衣服嚴具七寶所成積如須彌盡以供養，種植善根亦復如是。
english: If someone makes offerings to this sutra with incense, flowers, perfumed ointments, flower garlands, clothing, and exquisite ornaments, it is as if they have made offerings before ninety-nine hundred thousand million koṭis of Tathāgatas in the ten directions, using heavenly incense and flowers, clothing and ornaments made of the seven treasures piled as high as Mount Sumeru - all offered in worship. The planting of good roots is also just like this.

chinese: 」爾時天龍八部人非人等聞是說已，各懷希奇，互相謂言：「奇哉威德！
english: At that time, the eight classes of celestial beings—devas, nagas, and others, both human and non-human—having heard this teaching, each harbored feelings of wonder and said to one another: "How marvelous is this awesome virtue!"

chinese: 是朽土聚如來神力所加持故，有是神變。
english: Due to the divine power and blessing of the Tathagata, even a heap of rotten earth manifests such miraculous transformations.

chinese: 」金剛手復白佛言：「世尊！
english: The Vajrapani (Vajra-holder) again addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 何因緣故，是七寶塔現為土聚？
english: Why has this seven-jeweled stupa now appeared as a mound of earth?

chinese: 」佛告金剛手：「此非土聚，乃是殊妙大寶塔耳。
english: The Buddha told Vajrapani: "This is not a mound of earth, but rather a wonderful great jeweled stupa."

chinese: 由諸眾生業果劣故隱蔽不現。
english: Due to the inferior karmic fruits of sentient beings, it is concealed and does not appear.

chinese: 由塔隱故，如來全身非可毀壞，豈有如來金剛藏身而可壞哉？
english: Because the stupa is hidden, the Tathagata's entire body cannot be destroyed. How could the Tathagata's vajra treasury body possibly be destroyed?

chinese: 我若滅度，後世末法逼迫之時，若有眾生習行非法應墮地獄，不信三寶不植善根，為是因緣佛法當隱，然猶是塔堅固不滅，一切如來神力所持。
english: When I enter nirvana, in the future age of the final dharma during times of persecution, if there are sentient beings who practice unlawful acts and should fall into hell, who do not believe in the Three Jewels and do not plant good roots, because of these causes the Buddha-dharma will become hidden, yet still this stupa will remain firm and indestructible, sustained by the spiritual power of all Tathagatas.

chinese: 無智眾生惑障覆蔽，徒朽珍寶不知採用，以是事故我今流淚，彼諸如來亦皆流淚。
english: The ignorant sentient beings, covered and obscured by the hindrance of delusion, vainly let precious treasures decay without knowing how to gather and use them. Because of this matter, I now shed tears, and all those Tathāgatas also shed tears.

chinese: 」復次佛告金剛手言：「若有眾生書寫此經置塔中者，是塔即為一切如來金剛藏窣都婆，亦為一切如來陀羅尼心祕密加持窣都婆，即為九十九百千萬俱胝如來窣都婆，亦為一切如來佛頂佛眼窣都婆，即為一切如來神力所護。
english: Again the Buddha told Vajrapāṇi: "If there are beings who copy this sutra and place it in a stupa, that stupa immediately becomes the vajra treasury stupa of all Tathāgatas, and also becomes the secret blessing stupa of all Tathāgatas' dhāraṇī hearts. It becomes the stupa of ninety-nine hundred thousand million koṭis of Tathāgatas, and also becomes the stupa of all Tathāgatas' buddha-crown and buddha-eye. It is immediately protected by the spiritual power of all Tathāgatas."

chinese: 若佛像中、窣都婆中安置此經，其像即為七寶所成，靈驗應心，無願不滿；其窣都婆，傘蓋羅網輪橖露盤、德鈴鐸、楹礎基階隨力所，或土或木若石若甎，由經威力自為七寶。
english: If this sutra is placed inside a Buddha image or inside a stupa, that image will become as if made of the seven treasures, manifesting spiritual power in response to the heart, with no wish left unfulfilled. As for that stupa - its parasol, canopy, net ornaments, wheel finial, dew basin, bell chimes, pillars, foundation and steps, made according to one's ability either of earth, wood, stone or brick - through the power of the sutra they will naturally become the seven treasures.

chinese: 一切如來於此經典加其威力，以誠實言不斷加持。
english: All Tathagatas apply their spiritual power to this scripture, continuously blessing it with words of truth.

chinese: 若有有情能於此塔一香一華禮拜供養，八十億劫生死重罪一時消滅，生免災殃、死生佛家。
english: If there are sentient beings who can offer even a single incense stick or a single flower in worship and offering to this stupa, eighty billion kalpas of heavy karmic sins of birth and death will be eliminated at once. While alive they will be free from calamities and misfortune, and after death they will be born in the Buddha's household.

chinese: 若有應墮阿鼻地獄，若於此塔或一禮拜、或一右遶，塞地獄門、開菩提路。
english: If there are those who should fall into Avīci Hell, if they make even one prostration or one circumambulation to the right of this stupa, the gates of hell will be closed and the path to enlightenment will be opened.

chinese: 塔及形像所在之處，一切如來神力所護，其處不為暴風雷電霹靂所害，不為毒蛇蚖蝮毒蟲毒獸所傷，不為師子狂象、虎狼野干、蜂蠆之所傷害，亦無藥叉、羅剎、部多、那毘舍，遮魑魅魍魎癲癎之怖，亦復不為一切寒熱諸病、癧瘻癰疽、瘡疣疥癩所染。
english: Wherever stupas and images are located, they are protected by the spiritual power of all Tathagatas. Such places will not be harmed by violent winds, thunder, or lightning bolts; they will not be injured by poisonous snakes, vipers, venomous insects, or poisonous beasts; they will not be harmed by lions, mad elephants, tigers, wolves, wild dogs, or stinging wasps; there will be no fear from yakshas, rakshasas, pretas, pisachas, demons, ghosts, goblins, or epileptic seizures; nor will they be afflicted by any diseases of cold or heat, goiters, fistulas, abscesses, boils, sores, ulcers, scabies, or leprosy.

chinese: 若人暫見是塔，能除一切災難。
english: If a person briefly sees this stupa, they can eliminate all disasters and difficulties.

chinese: 其處亦無人馬六畜、童子童女疫癘之患。
english: There is also no plague affecting people, horses, the six types of livestock, boys, or girls in that place.

chinese: 不為橫死非命所夭。
english: You will not be cut short by violent death or unnatural fate.

chinese: 不為刀杖水火所傷、不為盜賊怨讎所侵、亦無飢饉貧乏之憂、厭魅呪咀不能得便。
english: They will not be harmed by swords, staves, water, or fire; they will not be invaded by thieves or enemies; they will have no worries of famine or poverty; and evil spells and curses cannot affect them.

chinese: 四大天王與諸眷屬晝夜衛護、二十八部大藥叉將、日月五星、幢雲彗星晝夜護持，一切龍王加其精氣順時降雨，一切諸天與忉利天三時下來亦為供養，一切諸仙三時來集讚詠旋遶禮謝瞻仰，釋提桓因與諸天女晝夜三時來下供養，其處即為一切如來護念加持。
english: The Four Heavenly Kings and their retinues guard and protect day and night; the twenty-eight great yakṣa generals, the sun, moon, five planets, banner clouds, and comets maintain their protection day and night. All dragon kings bestow their vital energy and send down rain in due season. All the devas together with those of the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven descend three times daily to make offerings. All the sages assemble three times daily to chant praises, circumambulate, pay reverence, and gaze in admiration. Śakra-devānām-indra and the celestial maidens descend three times each day and night to make offerings. That place receives the protective mindfulness and blessings of all Tathāgatas.

chinese: 由納經故，塔即如是。
english: Because of the enshrining of sutras, the stupa is thus.

chinese: 若人作塔以土石木金銀銅鉛，書此神呪安置其中，纔安置已其塔即為七寶所成，上下階級、露盤傘蓋、鈴鐸輪樘純為七寶，其塔四方如來形相，由法要故，一切如來堅住護持晝夜不去。
english: If a person builds a stupa using earth, stone, wood, gold, silver, copper, or lead, and writes this divine dharani and places it inside, as soon as it is placed, the stupa immediately becomes made of the seven jewels.
