The steps above and below, the露盤 (roban/harmika), umbrella canopy, bells, wheels, and pillars are all purely of the seven jewels. The stupa has images of the Tathagatas on its four sides. Due to the essential nature of the Dharma, all the Tathagatas firmly abide there, protecting and maintaining it, not departing day or night.

chinese: 其七寶塔全身舍利之妙寶藏，以呪威力，擢竦高至阿迦尼吒天宮之中，塔所串峙，一切諸天晝夜瞻仰守衛供養。
english: The wondrous treasure repository of the seven-jeweled stupa containing the whole body relics, through the power of the dharani, rises up majestically to the Akanishtha Heaven Palace. Where the stupa stands towering, all the devas gaze upon it with reverence day and night, guarding and making offerings to it.

chinese: 」金剛手言：「何因緣故，此法如是殊勝功德？
english: Vajrapani said: "What causes and conditions make this dharma have such extraordinary merit?"

chinese: 」佛言：「當知以此寶篋印陀羅尼威神力故。
english: The Buddha said: "You should know that it is due to the majestic spiritual power of this Jeweled Casket Seal Dhāraṇī.

chinese: 」金剛手言：「唯願如來哀愍我等，說是陀羅尼。
english: Vajrapani said: "We only wish that the Tathagata, out of compassion for us, would expound this dharani."

chinese: 」佛言：「諦聽，思念莫忘。
english: The Buddha said: "Listen carefully, contemplate and do not forget."

chinese: 現在未來一切如來分身光儀、過去諸佛全身舍利，皆在寶篋印陀羅尼，是諸如來所有三身亦在是中。
english: The light emanations and divided bodies of all Tathagatas of the present and future, and the complete body relics of all past Buddhas, are all within the Jeweled Casket Seal Dharani. The three bodies possessed by all these Tathagatas are also within this.

chinese: 」爾時世尊即說陀羅尼曰：「那莫悉怛哩野地尾迦南薩婆怛他蘖多喃唵部尾婆嚩娜嚩唎嚩者梨嚩者祖嚕祖嚕馱囉馱囉薩嚩怛他蘖多馱覩馱梨鉢娜婆嚩底惹也嚩梨畝怛梨薩磨囉怛他蘖多達磨斫迦囉鉢羅靺栗多娜嚩羅地滿拏楞迦囉楞訖哩諦薩嚩怛他多地瑟恥諦馱野馱野地地沒沒參馱儞參馱野者攞者攞者懶都薩嚩嚩囉拏儞薩嚩播波尾諦戶嚕戶嚕薩嚩戍迦弭帝薩嚩怛他多哩娜野嚩日囉抳三婆囉三婆囉薩嚩怛他多虞野馱囉抳畝涅梨沒悌蘇沒悌薩嚩怛他多地瑟恥多馱覩陛娑嚩賀三摩耶地瑟恥帝娑嚩訶薩嚩怛他多哩娜野馱覩畝捺犁娑嚩訶蘇鉢羅底瑟恥多薩覩閉怛他多地瑟恥帝戶嚕戶嚕吽吽娑嚩訶唵薩嚩怛他多塢瑟抳沙馱覩畝捺囉尼薩嚩怛他單娑馱覩尾部使多地瑟恥帝吽吽娑嚩訶」爾時佛說是神呪已，諸佛如來自土聚中出聲讚言：「善哉善哉！
english:
At that time, the World-Honored One spoke the dharani, saying: "Namo striya-dhivikanam sarva-tathagatanam om bhuvibhava-navari vachali vacha churu churu dhara dhara sarva-tathagata-dhatu-dharini padmabhavati jayavari mudri samara-tathagata dharma-chakra pravartana vara-dhimanda lamkara lamkriti sarva-tathagata-adhishthite dhaya dhaya dhi dhi bum bum samdhani samdhaya chala chala chalantu sarva-varanani sarva-papa-vigate huru huru sarva-shukla-mite sarva-tathagata-hridaya-vajrini sambhara sambhara sarva-tathagata-guhya-dharani mudri buddhe subuddhe sarva-tathagata-adhishthita-dhatu-bhe svaha samaya-adhishthite svaha sarva-tathagata-hridaya-dhatu-mudre svaha supratishthita-stupe tathagata-adhishthite huru huru hum hum svaha om sarva-tathagata-ushnisha-dhatu-mudrani sarva-tathagatam-dhatu-vibhushita-adhishthite hum hum svaha."

At that time, after the Buddha had spoken this divine spell, the Tathagatas from within the earth mound raised their voices in praise, saying: "Excellent! Excellent!"

chinese: 釋迦世尊出濁惡世，為利無依無怙眾生演說深法。
english: Śākyamuni Buddha appeared in the evil age of defilement to expound the profound Dharma for the benefit of sentient beings without refuge or protection.

chinese: 如是法要久住世間，利益廣多安穩快樂。
english: Thus may this Dharma teaching remain long in the world, bringing widespread benefit, peace, and happiness.

chinese: 」于時佛告金剛手言：「諦聽諦聽。
english: At that time, the Buddha said to Vajrapāṇi: "Listen carefully, listen carefully."

chinese: 如是法要神力無窮利益無邊，譬如幢上如意寶珠，常雨珍寶滿一切願。
english: This Dharma teaching has boundless spiritual power and limitless benefits, like a wish-fulfilling jewel atop a banner that constantly rains down precious treasures and fulfills all wishes.

chinese: 我今略說萬分之一，汝宜憶持利益一切。
english: I now briefly explain one part in ten thousand; you should remember and uphold this to benefit all beings.

chinese: 若有惡人死墮地獄，受苦無間免脫無期。
english: If there are evil people who die and fall into hell, they suffer without respite and are freed without end.

chinese: 有其子孫稱亡者名，誦上神呪纔至七遍，洋銅熱鐵忽然變為八功德池，蓮生承足寶蓋駐頂，地獄門破菩提道開，其蓮如飛至極樂界，一切種智自然顯發，樂說無窮位在補處。
english: When descendants call out the name of the deceased and recite this divine mantra just seven times, the molten copper and hot iron suddenly transform into pools of eight virtues, with lotuses arising to support their feet and jeweled canopies hovering overhead. The gates of hell break open and the path to enlightenment appears. The lotus flies swiftly to the Land of Ultimate Bliss, where omniscient wisdom naturally manifests, and they attain the stage of succession with endless eloquence in teaching the Dharma.

chinese: 復有眾生重罪報故，百病集身苦痛逼心，誦此神呪二十一遍，百病萬惱一時消滅，壽命延長福德無盡。
english: Again, there are sentient beings who, due to the ripening of heavy karma, have hundreds of diseases gathering in their bodies with suffering and pain oppressing their minds. If they recite this divine mantra twenty-one times, the hundreds of diseases and myriad afflictions will be eliminated all at once, their lifespan will be extended, and their blessings and virtues will be limitless.

chinese: 若復有人慳貪業故生貧窮家，衣不隱身食不續命，瘦衰蔽人所惡賤。
english: If there are those who, due to the karma of stinginess and greed, are born into poor families, their clothes do not cover their bodies and their food does not sustain their lives, emaciated and wretched, they are despised and looked down upon by others.

chinese: 是人慚愧入山折採無主搹華，若磨朽木持以號香，往至塔前禮拜供養，旋遶七匝流淚悔過，由神呪力及塔威德，滅貧窮報富貴忽至，七寶如雨無所闕乏。
english: This person, feeling ashamed, goes into the mountains to gather ownerless flowers, or grinds decayed wood to use as incense, then goes before the stupa to worship and make offerings, circumambulating it seven times while shedding tears and repenting their faults. Through the power of the divine dharani and the spiritual virtue of the stupa, the retribution of poverty is eliminated and wealth suddenly arrives - the seven treasures rain down like rain with nothing lacking.

chinese: 但當此時，彌飾佛法施與貧乏，若有悋惜財寶忽滅。
english: But at this time, if one adorns the Buddha Dharma and gives to the poor and destitute, yet harbors stinginess, their treasures will suddenly vanish.

chinese: 若復有人為種善根隨分造塔，或泥或甎隨力所，大如菴羅高四指許，書寫神呪安置其中，持以香華禮拜供養。
english: If there are people who, in order to plant good roots, build stupas according to their means—whether of clay or brick, according to their ability—as large as an amalaka fruit and four fingers high, write the divine mantra and place it inside, and worship and make offerings with incense and flowers.

chinese: 以其呪力及信心故，自小塔中出大香雲，香氣雲光周遍法界，薰馥晃曜廣作佛事，所得功德如上所說，取要言之無願不滿。
english: Through the power of the mantra and the strength of faith, great fragrant clouds emerge from the small stupa. The fragrant vapors and luminous clouds pervade throughout the Dharma realm, spreading their sweet aroma and radiant illumination, extensively performing Buddha's work. The merits thus obtained are as described above - in short, no wish remains unfulfilled.

chinese: 若薄福不信者，亦心生信解，亦得同超佛境，真實不虛。
english: If those of little fortune who do not believe can also give rise to faith and understanding in their hearts, they too can transcend to the Buddha realm - this is truly real and not false.

chinese: 夫觀世音誓願弘深，發大悲心，以濟度群生。
english: The Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara's vows are profound and vast, arousing the mind of great compassion to save and deliver all sentient beings.

chinese: 朕君臨天下，閔眾情之昏瞀，墮五濁而不知，以此經呪，用是方便，覺悟提撕，俾一切庶類，皆超佛域。
english: I reign over all under Heaven, and grieve that the multitudes' emotions are benighted and confused, fallen into the five defilements without knowing it. Through this sutra and mantra, using these expedient means, I awaken and guide them, so that all living beings may transcend to the Buddha realm.

chinese: 又況如來化導，首重忠孝。
english: Furthermore, the Tathagata's transformative guidance places foremost importance on loyalty and filial piety.

chinese: 凡忠臣孝子，能盡心以事君，竭力以事親，所作所為，無私智陂行，廣積陰功，濟人利物，又能持誦是經呪，則跬步之間，即見如來。
english: All loyal ministers and filial children who can exhaust their hearts in serving their lords, exert all their strength in serving their parents, whose every action and deed is without selfish wisdom or crooked behavior, who broadly accumulate hidden merit, benefit people and aid all things, and who can moreover uphold and recite this sutra and mantra - within but a few steps, they shall see the Tathagata.

chinese: 若彼不忠不孝，不知敬畏，則鬼神所錄，陰加譴罰，轉眄之間，即成地獄。
english: If they are disloyal and unfilial, and do not know reverence and fear, then they will be recorded by ghosts and spirits, who will secretly inflict punishment upon them. In the blink of an eye, it becomes hell.

chinese: 蓋善惡兩途，由人所趨，凡我眾庶，宜慎取舍，書此以為勸！
english: Good and evil are two paths, chosen by people themselves. All of us common folk should carefully consider our choices. I write this as an exhortation!

chinese: 永樂九年六月日如是我聞：一時，釋迦牟尼佛在補陀落迦山，觀世音宮殿，寶莊嚴道場中，坐寶師子座。
english: In the ninth year of Yongle, on the sixth month and day, thus have I heard: At one time, Shakyamuni Buddha was at Mount Potalaka, in the palace of Avalokiteshvara, in the jewel-adorned place of enlightenment, seated on a precious lion throne.

chinese: 其座純以無量雜摩尼寶，而用莊嚴，百寶幢旛，周匝懸列。
english: Its throne is adorned purely with countless various maṇi jewels, with hundreds of precious banners and streamers suspended and arrayed all around.

chinese: 爾時，如來於彼座上，將欲演說總持陀羅尼故。
english: At that time, the Tathāgata, seated upon that throne, was about to expound the dhāraṇī of total retention.

chinese: 與無央數菩薩摩訶薩俱，其名曰：總持王菩薩、寶王菩薩、藥王菩薩、藥上菩薩、觀世音菩薩、大勢至菩薩、華嚴菩薩、大莊嚴菩薩、寶藏菩薩、德藏菩薩、金剛藏菩薩、虛空藏菩薩、彌勒菩薩、普賢菩薩、文殊師利菩薩，如是等菩薩摩訶薩，皆是灌頂大法王子。
english: Together with countless bodhisattva-mahasattvas, whose names were: Dharaniraja Bodhisattva, Ratnaraja Bodhisattva, Bhaisajyaraja Bodhisattva, Bhaisajyasamudgata Bodhisattva, Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Avatamsaka Bodhisattva, Mahalamkara Bodhisattva, Ratnagarbha Bodhisattva, Gunagarbha Bodhisattva, Vajragarbha Bodhisattva, Akasagarbha Bodhisattva, Maitreya Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, and Manjusri Bodhisattva. All such bodhisattva-mahasattvas were anointed great Dharma princes.

chinese: 又與無量無數大聲聞僧，皆行阿羅漢十地，摩訶迦葉而為上首。
english: And together with innumerable and countless great śrāvaka monks, all practicing the ten stages of the arhat path, with Mahākāśyapa as their leader.

chinese: 又與無量梵摩羅天，善吒梵摩而為上首。
english: And with countless Brahma-mara devas, with Suddhavasa Brahma as their leader.

chinese: 又與無量欲界諸天子俱，瞿婆伽天子而為上首。
english: And together with countless celestial beings from the Desire Realm, with Guhyaka as the foremost among them.

chinese: 又與無量護世四王俱，提頭賴吒而為上首。
english: Again, together with countless World-Protecting Four Kings, with Dhṛtarāṣṭra as the foremost.

chinese: 又與無量天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿修羅、迦樓羅、緊那羅、摩睺羅伽、人、非人等俱，天德大龍王而為上首。
english: Also together with countless devas, nagas, yakshas, gandharvas, asuras, garudas, kinnaras, mahoragas, humans, non-humans and others, with the Heavenly Virtue Great Dragon King as the foremost leader.

chinese: 又與無量欲界諸天女俱，童目天女而為上首。
english: Together with countless celestial maidens of the Desire Realm, with the Maiden of Youthful Eyes as their leader.

chinese: 又與無量虛空神、江海神、泉源神、河沼神、藥草神、樹林神、舍宅神、水神、火神、地神、風神、土神、山神、石神、宮殿等神，皆來集會。
english: Together with countless gods of space, gods of rivers and seas, gods of springs and sources, gods of rivers and marshes, gods of medicinal herbs, gods of forests, gods of dwellings, gods of water, gods of fire, gods of earth, gods of wind, gods of soil, gods of mountains, gods of stones, gods of palaces, and others, all came to gather in assembly.

chinese: 時觀世音菩薩，於大會中密放神通，光明照曜，十方剎土及此三千大千世界，皆作金色。
english: At that time, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva secretly emitted divine powers in the great assembly. Radiant light shone brilliantly, and the lands of the ten directions as well as this three-thousand great thousand world system all turned golden in color.

chinese: 天宮、龍宮、諸尊神宮，皆悉震動；江河、大海、鐵圍山、須彌山、土山、黑山，亦皆大動。
english: The heavenly palaces, dragon palaces, and all the sacred shrines of the deities trembled and shook; the rivers, great oceans, Iron Encircling Mountains, Mount Sumeru, earthen mountains, and black mountains also all shook violently.

chinese: 日、月、珠、火、星宿之光，皆悉不現。
english: The light of the sun, moon, pearls, fire, and constellations all cease to appear.

chinese: 於是總持王菩薩，見此希有之相，怪曾有。
english: Then the Bodhisattva King of Total Retention, seeing this extraordinary and rare sign, marveled that such a thing had never been.

chinese: 即從座起，叉手合掌，以偈問佛，如此神通之相，是誰所放？
english: Rising from his seat, with hands joined together in reverence, he asked the Buddha in verse: "These manifestations of supernatural powers - who has displayed them?"

chinese: 以偈問曰：「誰於今日成正覺？
english: By verse he asked: "Who has attained perfect enlightenment today?"

chinese: 普放如是大光明，十方剎土皆金色，三千世界亦復然。
english: Universally radiating such great luminosity, all lands in the ten directions become golden in color, and the three thousand worlds are likewise transformed.

chinese: 誰於今日得自在？
english: Who has attained freedom today?

chinese: 演放希有大神力，無邊佛國皆震動，龍神宮殿悉不安。
english:
Displaying rare and great spiritual power,
All boundless Buddha lands trembled,
The palaces of dragons and spirits were all disturbed.

chinese: 今此大眾咸有疑，不測因緣是誰力？
english: Now this great assembly all has doubts - whose power is behind these unfathomable causes and conditions?

chinese: 為佛菩薩大聲聞？
english: To be Buddha, Bodhisattvas, and great Sravakas?

chinese: 為梵魔天諸釋等？
english: Do they act as Brahma, Mara, heavenly beings, and various Indras?

chinese: 唯願世尊大慈悲，說此神通所由以！
english: I only wish that the World-Honored One, with great compassion, would explain the origin of these supernatural powers!

chinese: 」佛告總持王菩薩言：「善男子！
english: The Buddha said to Bodhisattva Dharaṇī King: "Good man!"

chinese: 汝等當知，今此會中，有一菩薩摩訶薩，名曰『觀世音自在』。
english: You should all know that in this assembly there is a Bodhisattva Mahasattva named 'Avalokiteśvara'.

chinese: 從無量劫來，成就大慈大悲，善能修習無量陀羅尼門，為欲安樂諸眾生故，密放如是大神通力。
english: From countless kalpas past, having accomplished great compassion and great loving-kindness, skillfully able to cultivate immeasurable dhāraṇī gates, for the sake of bringing peace and happiness to all sentient beings, secretly releases such great supernatural powers.

chinese: 」佛說是語已。
english: When the Buddha had finished speaking these words.

chinese: 爾時，觀世音菩薩，從座而起，整理衣服，向佛合掌，白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva rose from his seat, arranged his robes, joined his palms toward the Buddha, and addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 我有大悲心陀羅尼呪，今當欲說。
english: I have the Great Compassion Dhāraṇī mantra, which I shall now proclaim.

chinese: 為諸眾生得安樂故，除一切病故，得壽命故，得富饒故，滅除一切惡業、重罪故，離障難故，增長一切白法諸功德故，成就一切諸善根故，遠離一切諸怖畏故，速能滿足一切諸希求故。
english: For the sake of all sentient beings attaining peace and happiness, for eliminating all illnesses, for obtaining longevity, for gaining abundance and wealth, for eradicating all evil karma and grave sins, for being free from obstacles and difficulties, for increasing all pure dharmas and various merits, for accomplishing all wholesome roots, for being far removed from all fears, and for swiftly fulfilling all aspirations.

chinese: 惟願世尊，慈哀聽許！
english: I only wish that the World-Honored One, with compassion and pity, would grant permission to listen!

chinese: 」佛言：「善男子！
english: The Buddha said: "Good man!

chinese: 汝大慈悲，安樂眾生。
english: You, of great compassion, bring peace and joy to all beings.

chinese: 欲說神呪，今正是時，宜應速說。
english: Desiring to speak the divine spell, now is precisely the right time; you should speak it quickly.

chinese: 如來隨喜，諸佛亦然。
english: The Tathagata rejoices accordingly, and all Buddhas likewise.

chinese: 」觀世音菩薩重白佛言：「世尊！
english: "The Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara again addressed the Buddha, saying: 'World-Honored One!"

chinese: 我念過去無量億劫，有佛出世，名曰『千光王靜住如來』。
english: I recall that in the past, countless millions of kalpas ago, there was a Buddha who appeared in the world named 'Thousand Light King Tranquil Dwelling Tathagata'.

chinese: 彼佛世尊憐念我故，及為一切諸眾生故，說此『廣大圓滿無礙大悲心陀羅尼』。
english: That Buddha, the World-Honored One, out of compassion for me and for the sake of all sentient beings, expounded this 'Dhāraṇī of the Vast, Perfect, Unobstructed Great Compassionate Heart.'

chinese: 以金色手摩我頂上作如是言：『善男子！
english: With golden-colored hands rubbing the crown of my head, [he] spoke these words: "Good man!"

chinese: 汝當持此心呪，普為未來惡世一切眾生，作大利樂。
english: You should uphold this heart mantra and universally bring great benefit and joy to all sentient beings in the evil age to come.

chinese: 』「我於是時，始住初地，一聞此呪故，超第八地。
english: At that time, I had just begun to abide in the First Ground, but upon hearing this dhāraṇī once, I transcended directly to the Eighth Ground.

chinese: 我時心歡喜故，即發誓言：『若我當來，堪能利益、安樂一切眾生者，令我即時，身生千手、千眼具足。
english: At that time, my heart filled with joy, I immediately made a vow: "If in the future I am capable of benefiting and bringing peace to all sentient beings, may I at this very moment be endowed with a thousand hands and a thousand eyes complete."

chinese: 』「發是願已，應時身上，千手千眼，悉皆具足；十方大地，六種震動；十方千佛，悉放光明，照觸我身，及照十方，無邊世界。
english: Having made this vow, immediately on my body a thousand hands and a thousand eyes were all completely manifested. The great earth in the ten directions shook in six ways. The thousand Buddhas of the ten directions all emitted light, illuminating and touching my body, and illuminating the infinite worlds in the ten directions.

chinese: 「從是已後，復於無量佛所、無量會中，重更得聞，親承受持，是陀羅尼。
english: "From then onward, at countless Buddha assemblies in the presence of countless Buddhas, I repeatedly heard again, personally received and upheld this dhāraṇī.

chinese: 復生歡喜，踊躍無量，便得超越無數億劫微細生死。
english: They again gave rise to joy and leaped with boundless delight, and thereby were able to transcend countless billions of kalpas of subtle births and deaths.

chinese: 從是已來，常所誦持，未曾廢忘，由持此呪故，所生之處，恒在佛前，蓮華化生，不受胎藏之身。
english: Since then, I have constantly recited and upheld it, never once abandoning or forgetting it. By upholding this mantra, wherever I am reborn, I am always in the presence of the Buddha, born by transformation from a lotus flower, not receiving a body from the womb.

chinese: 「若有比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷、童男、童女，欲誦持者，於諸眾生，起慈悲心，先當從我，發如是願：「『大悲觀世音！
english: "If there are bhikshus, bhikshunis, upasakas, upasikas, boys, or girls who wish to recite and uphold [this], they should generate compassion towards all sentient beings and first make this vow before me: 'Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!"

chinese: 願我速知一切法。
english: May I quickly know all dharmas.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早得智慧眼。
english: May I soon attain the eye of wisdom.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我速度一切眾。
english: May I swiftly liberate all beings.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早得善方便。
english: May I quickly attain skillful means.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: I take refuge in the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我速乘般若船。
english: May I swiftly board the ship of Prajñā.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我早得越苦海。
english: May I soon cross over the sea of suffering.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Namo Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速得戒定道。
english: May I quickly attain the path of precepts and concentration.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我早登涅槃山。
english: May I soon ascend Mount Nirvana.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速會無為舍。
english: May I quickly reach the abode of non-action.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Namo Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早同法性身。
english: May I soon unite with the Dharma-nature body.

chinese: 「『我若向刀山，刀山自摧折。
english: "If I approach the mountain of knives, the mountain of knives will crumble of itself."

chinese: 我若向火湯，火湯自消滅。
english: If I face fire and boiling water, the fire and boiling water will naturally be extinguished.

chinese: 我若向地獄，地獄自枯竭。
english: If I go to hell, hell will dry up and be exhausted.

chinese: 我若向餓鬼，餓鬼自飽滿。
english: If I turn toward the hungry ghosts, the hungry ghosts naturally become satisfied.

chinese: 我若向修羅，惡心自調伏。
english: If I face the asuras, their evil minds will naturally be subdued.

chinese: 我若向畜生，自得大智慧。
english: If I turn toward animals, I naturally attain great wisdom.

chinese: 若有在家善男女等誦持之者，其家無有災橫病苦之所惱害，諸有所作無不諧偶，所言人皆信受。
english: If there are lay men and women of good faith who recite and uphold this, their households will have no calamities, misfortunes, illnesses, or sufferings to cause them distress. All their undertakings will be harmonious and successful, and whatever they say, people will believe and accept.

chinese: 若有誦此陀羅尼呪滿十萬遍，夢中得見諸佛、菩薩、聲聞、緣覺，自見口中出黑。
english: If one recites this dharani spell a full hundred thousand times, in dreams they will see all Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, Sravakas, and Pratyekabuddhas, and will see black [substance] coming out from their own mouth.

chinese: 若有重罪，誦滿二十萬遍，夢中亦見諸佛菩薩，亦自出黑。
english: If there are grave sins, recite it a full 200,000 times, and in dreams you will also see all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, and blackness will also emerge from yourself.

chinese: 若有五逆，不得如是善夢應更誦滿七十萬遍，是時還得如前之相。
english: If one has committed the five heinous crimes, one cannot obtain such auspicious dreams. One should then recite it a full seven hundred thousand times, and at that time one will again obtain the signs as before.

chinese: 乃至夢見出白色，當知此人即是罪滅清淨之相。
english: Even dreaming of white color appearing, you should know this person has the sign of sins being extinguished and purity.

chinese: 「復次我今說大陀羅尼所作之事。
english: "Next, I will now explain the deeds accomplished by the great dhāraṇī."

chinese: 若於佛像前、或於塔前、若清淨處，以瞿摩塗地而作方壇，隨其大小。
english: If before a Buddha image, or before a stupa, or in a clean place, one smears the ground with cow dung to make a square altar, according to whatever size.

chinese: 復以花、香、幡蓋、食、，隨力所辦而供養之。
english: Again, with flowers, incense, banners, canopies, and food, they make offerings according to their ability.

chinese: 復呪香水散於四上下，以為結。
english: Again cast the spell on fragrant water and scatter it above and below in the four directions, thereby creating a boundary.

chinese: 於壇四角及壇中央，皆各置一香水之瓶。
english: At the four corners of the altar and in the center of the altar, place one bottle of fragrant water in each location.

chinese: 持呪之者於其壇中，面向東方跪，誦呪一千遍，其香水瓶即便自。
english: The mantra practitioner kneels in the altar facing east and recites the mantra one thousand times, whereupon the perfumed water vessel will spontaneously [move/act].

chinese: 叉手捧雜花，呪遍，散一鏡面；又於鏡前正，誦呪亦，得見佛菩薩像。
english: With joined hands holding various flowers, after reciting the mantra throughout, scatter them on the mirror's surface; then sitting properly before the mirror and also reciting the mantra, one can see the images of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

chinese: 呪花八遍，而散供，請問無不決了。
english: Recite the mantra over the flowers eight times, then scatter them as an offering. Any question asked will be resolved without fail.

chinese: 若有鬼病，以茅而拂病人，即得除愈。
english: If there is a ghost-caused illness, by brushing the sick person with cogon grass, they will be cured immediately.

chinese: 若有幼小為鬼所著，以五色縷，應令童女以線，一呪一結滿二十，用繫其頸，芥子呪七遍，其面，即便除。
english: If there are young children possessed by ghosts, use five-colored thread. Have a virgin girl take the thread and make one knot with each incantation until reaching twenty knots, then tie it around the child's neck. Recite the mustard seed incantation seven times over their face, and it will immediately be removed.

chinese: 「復次有法，於病者墨畫其，呪楊枝打，亦除。
english: "Furthermore, there is a method: draw it in ink on the sick person, chant a spell over a willow branch and strike with it, this will also cure them."

chinese: 「復法，若有病人為鬼所著，身在遠處，應呪楊枝滿七遍，寄持打，即亦除。
english: "Another method: If there is a sick person who is possessed by a ghost and their body is in a distant place, one should chant a spell over willow branches seven full times, then send them to be used for striking [the person], and this will also eliminate [the possession]."

chinese: 「復法，若在路行，此呪，無有賊盜惡獸等。
english: "Furthermore, if one travels on the road with this mantra, there will be no bandits, thieves, or evil beasts."

chinese: 「復法，常持此呪，設有諍訟無不獲勝。
english: "Another method: if you constantly recite this mantra, even if there are disputes or lawsuits, you will never fail to win."

chinese: 若欲往渡江河大海，誦呪而渡，無有水中惡獸等難。
english: If one wishes to cross rivers and great seas, by reciting this mantra while crossing, there will be no difficulties from evil beasts and such in the water.

chinese: 「復法，若被繫閉枷鎖其身，誦此呪者，即得解脫。
english: "Furthermore, if one is bound, imprisoned, shackled, or fettered in body, by reciting this mantra, one will immediately gain liberation."

chinese: 「復法，若諸國土水旱不調、疫毒流，應以酥和胡麻、粳米，用手三指取其一撮，呪之一遍火中燒。
english: "Furthermore, if in various countries there is imbalance of water and drought, or epidemic diseases spread, one should mix ghee with sesame seeds and japonica rice, take a pinch with three fingers, recite a spell over it once, and burn it in fire.

chinese: 或經七日七夜，六時如是相續不絕，一切災疫消。
english: The calamities may last for seven days and seven nights, continuing uninterrupted through the six time periods, until all disasters and epidemics are eliminated.

chinese: 「復法，於河渚間砂潬之上，印印為塔形像，誦呪一遍印成一塔，六十萬遍，觀菩、或見多羅菩薩、金剛菩薩，心皆得滿足，或見授與藥，或見菩提之記。
english: Again, the method: on the sandy islets between river shores, make imprints in the shape of stupas. Recite the mantra once for each stupa imprint formed. After six hundred thousand times, you will see Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, or see Tārā Bodhisattva, or Vajra Bodhisattva, and your heart will attain complete satisfaction. Some may see the bestowal of medicine, or see the prediction of enlightenment.

chinese: 「復，右遶菩提樹像，誦呪滿千萬遍，即見菩薩為其說法，欲隨菩薩即得隨從。
english: "Again, circumambulating clockwise around the Bodhi tree image and reciting the mantra a full ten million times, one will immediately see the Bodhisattva expounding the Dharma for them. If one wishes to follow the Bodhisattva, they will immediately be able to accompany them."

chinese: 「復法，若乞食時常持此呪，不為惡人惡狗等類之所害。
english: "Furthermore, if one constantly recites this mantra while begging for alms, one will not be harmed by evil people, vicious dogs, or other such beings."

chinese: 塔前或佛像前或舍利塔前，誦持此呪三十萬遍，於白月十五日設大供養，一日一夜不食正誦呪，得見金剛手菩薩，而彼菩薩即將是往於自宮。
english: In front of a stupa, before a Buddha image, or before a relic stupa, recite this mantra 300,000 times. On the fifteenth day of the bright moon, arrange a great offering. Fast for one day and one night while properly reciting the mantra, and you will see Vajrapani Bodhisattva, who will then take you to his own palace.

chinese: 「復法，若於轉法輪塔前、或佛生處塔前、或忉利天下寶階塔前、或舍利塔前，於如是等諸塔之前誦呪右遶，即見阿鉢羅是多菩薩及訶利底菩薩，隨其所願皆悉滿足，若須仙藥即便授之，復為說法示菩薩道。
english: "Again, as for the method: if one recites this mantra while circumambulating clockwise before a Dharma Wheel Turning Stupa, or before a stupa at the Buddha's birthplace, or before the Jeweled Stairway Stupa where he descended from Trayastriṃśa Heaven, or before a śarīra stupa - before any such stupas - one will see Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and Hārītī Bodhisattva. Whatever one wishes will all be fulfilled. If one needs immortal medicine, it will be granted immediately. Furthermore, they will expound the Dharma and reveal the bodhisattva path."

chinese: 若有誦此陀羅尼者，乃至未坐道場，一切菩薩為友。
english: If there are those who recite this dhāraṇī, even before they sit at the place of enlightenment, all bodhisattvas will be their friends.

chinese: 又此准提大陀羅尼大明呪法，過去一切諸佛已說、、，我今亦如是說，為利一切眾生故、得無上菩提故。
english: Furthermore, this Cundī Great Dhāraṇī Great Illuminating Mantra teaching has been expounded by all Buddhas of the past, and I now also expound it in the same way, for the benefit of all sentient beings and for the attainment of supreme enlightenment.

chinese: 若有薄福眾生，少善根者、無有根器之者、無有者，若得聞此羅尼法，速疾證得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提。
english: If there are beings of little merit, those with few good roots, those without capacity, those who have nothing - if they hear this dharani teaching, they will quickly attain anuttara-samyak-sambodhi.

chinese: 若有人念，，無量善根皆得成就。
english: If someone recites it, immeasurable good roots will all be accomplished.

chinese: 」佛說此大准提陀羅尼法時，無量眾生遠塵離垢，得大准提陀羅尼大明呪功德，得見十方諸佛菩聖眾，作禮而去。
english: When the Buddha spoke this great Cundī dhāraṇī teaching, countless sentient beings removed dust and departed from defilement, obtained the merit of the great Cundī dhāraṇī great vidyā mantra, were able to see the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and sacred assemblies of the ten directions, paid reverence and departed.

chinese: 爾時普賢菩薩得諸佛心印，即住金剛壽命三昧耶，於身毛孔中放無量微塵等數光遍十方界，以自在神通力即說陀羅尼曰：「怛儞也他者隷者攞者隷尾曩知娑縛悉底計斫羯誐爾鉢囉捨漫覩薩嚩路誐薩嚩娑怛嚩南阿曩句曩摩賀曩者隷者隷係摩誤憍哩係摩儞鏟禰係摩尸棄矯囉吠矯囉悌係俱囉吠俱囉俱囉摩底微捨摩寧摩寧戍毘嚩阿者梨微者梨摩尾覽嚩呼牟呼牟唵嚩日囉諭曬娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，大地山河悉皆振動，地獄摧碎、宮震動，病苦眾生當時蘇息。
english:
At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva received the mind-seal of all Buddhas and immediately abided in the Vajra Life-span Samaya. From the pores of his body, he emitted countless lights equal to the number of infinitesimal dust particles, pervading the realms of the ten directions. With the power of unimpeded supernatural abilities, he then spoke this dhāraṇī:

"Tadyathā cale cala cale vināyaka svasti ke cakra garbhe praśamantu sarva roga sarva sattvānāṃ anākula mahānā cale cale he mārgaḥ kauri he mani caṇḍe he maśikhi kaura ve kaura dhe he kura ve kura kura mati viśama ni mani śubha ācari vicari mavilam ba hūṃ hūṃ oṃ vajra-āyuṣe svāhā"

After speaking this dhāraṇī, the great earth and mountains all shook and trembled, hells were shattered, palaces quaked, and suffering sentient beings immediately found relief.

chinese: 會中有無量執金剛神，異口同音亦共宣說，諸大菩薩摩訶薩眾悉助延命宣說陀羅尼，令獲金剛壽命。
english: In the assembly, there were countless vajra-holding deities who, with different mouths but the same voice, also proclaimed together. All the great bodhisattva-mahāsattvas assisted in proclaiming the life-extending dhāraṇī, causing beings to obtain vajra-like longevity.

chinese: 爾時十方塵沙諸佛心印加持，令普賢菩薩及四天王增得金剛壽命。
english: At that time, the Buddhas as numerous as dust particles in the ten directions bestowed their mind-seal empowerment, causing Bodhisattva Samantabhadra and the Four Heavenly Kings to gain increased vajra longevity.

chinese: 爾時世尊彈指讚嘆：「汝能快善利益眾生。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One snapped his fingers and praised: "How well you can swiftly benefit sentient beings!"

chinese: 若有善男子善女人，怖畏夭橫非命及不祥事，即以沐浴、著新淨衣、燒香散花，持我延命心真言，即增壽。
english: If there are good men and good women who fear untimely death, unnatural death, and inauspicious events, then by bathing, wearing new clean clothes, burning incense, scattering flowers, and reciting my life-extending heart mantra, their lifespan will be increased.

chinese: 若有病苦眾生求長壽故，離於病苦，即建立道場於清淨屋舍或就伽藍，請三七比丘清淨僧，轉讀此經各四十九遍，別持是陀羅尼滿十萬遍，即獲壽命。
english: If there are sick and suffering sentient beings who seek longevity and wish to be free from illness and suffering, they should establish a ritual site in a pure dwelling or at a monastery, invite twenty-one pure monks, have them recite this sutra forty-nine times each, and separately recite this dharani one hundred thousand times - then they will obtain long life.

chinese: 病者即於夜夢，自見殊勝境界。
english: The sick person immediately dreams at night, seeing for themselves extraordinary realms.

chinese: 我此延命法，先須彩書普賢菩薩，如滿月童子形，五佛頭冠，右手持金剛杵、左手持召集金剛鈴契，鬘縱緩帶，坐千葉寶華。
english: This life-extending method of mine first requires painting Samantabhadra Bodhisattva in the form of a full moon youth, wearing a five-Buddha crown, holding a vajra in the right hand and a summoning vajra bell mudra in the left hand, with garlands and flowing sashes, seated on a thousand-petaled jeweled lotus.

chinese: 下有白象王，象有三頭，鼻卷獨股杵，各具六牙。
english: Below there is a white elephant king. The elephant has three heads, with trunks holding single-pronged vajras, each possessing six tusks.

chinese: 其象四足踏一大金剛輪。
english: Its elephant has four feet treading on a great vajra wheel.

chinese: 輪下有五千群象，各負其輪。
english: Beneath each wheel are five thousand elephants in herds, each carrying its wheel.

chinese: 於菩薩身放百寶光，光外盡白。
english: From the Bodhisattva's body radiated a hundred-jeweled light, beyond which all was white.

chinese: 月輪眾彩莊嚴，盡得其像。
english: The moon disc adorned with myriad colors, fully manifesting its form.

chinese: 敬於清淨處建立道場，令清淨僧持是真言，及轉此經，乃至書寫及持金剛壽命陀羅尼滿十萬遍，即增壽命，除夭橫故。
english: At a pure place, establish a ritual ground. Have pure monks uphold this true mantra and recite this sutra, as well as copy and hold the Vajra Life Dhāraṇī, completing one hundred thousand recitations. This will then increase lifespan and eliminate untimely death.

chinese: 」爾時四天王等承佛加持，助普賢菩薩延命，各立誓言：「娑婆世界南贍部洲但有此經法流行之處，我等四王即為結護，令無夭橫。
english: At that time, the Four Heavenly Kings and others, receiving the Buddha's empowerment to assist Bodhisattva Samantabhadra in extending life, each made this vow: "Wherever this sutra teaching circulates in Jambudvipa of the Saha world, we Four Kings shall provide protection, preventing untimely deaths and calamities."

chinese: 如有此經清淨道場，如不降赴，願我失此威光、損我果報，退失菩提心，不得解脫。
english: If there is such a sutra in a pure place of practice, and I do not descend to attend, may I lose this majestic radiance, may my karmic rewards be diminished, may I regress from the bodhi mind, and may I not attain liberation.

chinese: 」爾時十方如來加持一切執金剛菩薩，異口同音亦說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢吽吽尸棄娑嚩賀」如是說已，一切如來、十方執金剛菩薩隱於虛中已不現。
english: At that time, the Tathagatas of the ten directions blessed all the Vajradhara Bodhisattvas, and with different mouths but the same voice, they also spoke the life-extending dharani, saying: "Om vajra-ayuse hum hum sikhi svaha." Having spoken thus, all the Tathagatas and the Vajradhara Bodhisattvas of the ten directions concealed themselves in the void and disappeared.

chinese: 爾時毘沙門天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Vaiśravaṇa, the Heavenly King, addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力加持護念，除非命故，說陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日囉諭勢。
english: I also, through the divine power of assisting the Buddha, bestow blessings and protective mindfulness. Except in cases of predetermined death, I speak this dhāraṇī, saying: "Oṃ vajra-yuṣe."

chinese: 濕吠帝濕吠帝濕吠多隷理娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，令一切眾生獲得壽命，無夭橫故。
english: "Svasti svasti svastāya svāhā!" Having spoken this dhāraṇī, it causes all sentient beings to obtain longevity, free from untimely death.

chinese: 爾時毘樓勒叉天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Virūḍhaka, the Heavenly King, addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力，宣說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢摩蹬儗摩蹬儗摩蹬儗儞輸摩輸謀嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，獲得壽命，無夭橫故。
english: "I also, through the power of assisting the Buddha, proclaim the life-extending dharani, saying: 'Om vajra-yuṣe ma-daṅgi ma-daṅgi ma-daṅgi niśu maśu mo svāhā.' Having spoken this dharani, one obtains longevity and is free from premature or violent death."

chinese: 爾時毘樓博叉天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Virūpākṣa, the Heavenly King, addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力故，助宣延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢者理者理者理隷」說是陀羅尼，令諸眾生獲金剛壽命，無夭橫故。
english: I also, through the power of assisting the Buddha, help proclaim the life-extending dhāraṇī, saying: "OṂ VAJRA-YUṢE CARI CARI CARI CALE." By speaking this dhāraṇī, all sentient beings attain vajra longevity, free from untimely death.

chinese: 爾時提頭賴吒天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the Heavenly King Dhṛtarāṣṭra addressed the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 我亦以佛神力，宣說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢未臨嚩嚩嚩娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，令諸眾生獲金剛壽命，無夭橫故。
english: I too, by the Buddha's spiritual power, proclaim the life-extending dhāraṇī, saying: "Oṃ vajra-yuṣe svāhā." Having spoken this dhāraṇī, I cause all sentient beings to attain vajra longevity, free from untimely death.

chinese: 爾時佛告四天王言：「若有眾生怖畏死難、病苦夭橫，有如是苦，但書寫此經受持讀誦，或別持此陀羅尼，或畫普賢延命像。
english: At that time, the Buddha said to the Four Heavenly Kings: "If there are sentient beings who fear death, calamity, illness, suffering, or untimely demise, and experience such sufferings, they need only copy this sutra, uphold it, read and recite it, or separately uphold this dharani, or paint an image of Samantabhadra for Longevity.

chinese: 作此方法，依月一日八日十五日建立道場，燒四十九燈，花香果藥各置十六器散於壇上，合掌禮拜高聲讚詠此陀羅尼及懺悔往咎，不墮三惡道，捨此身獲得金剛壽命，更不輪迴。
english: Following this method, establish a ritual site on the 1st, 8th, and 15th days of the month. Light forty-nine lamps, place flowers, incense, fruits, and medicinal herbs in sixteen vessels each, and scatter them upon the altar. With palms joined, bow in reverence and chant this dhāraṇī in a loud voice while repenting past transgressions. You will not fall into the three evil paths, and upon abandoning this body, you will obtain the adamantine lifespan and no longer undergo rebirth.

chinese: 若有比丘尼及四眾，轉讀此經而不廢忘，離於短命夭橫之怖，及夜惡夢厭魅呪咀、惡形羅剎鳥鳴百怪之屬，亦不為水火兵毒之所傷害。
english: If there are bhikṣuṇīs and the four assemblies who recite and read this sutra without neglecting or forgetting it, they will be free from the fear of short life and untimely death, as well as from nightmares, evil spirits, curses, malevolent rākṣasas, inauspicious bird cries, and the hundred strange phenomena. Neither will they be harmed by water, fire, weapons, or poison.

chinese: 一切諸佛及大菩薩攝受護念，亦得諸佛之所護念。
english: All Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas embrace, receive, protect and be mindful of [them], and [they] also receive the protection and mindfulness of all Buddhas.

chinese: 」爾時世尊說是經已，菩薩摩訶薩、天人、四眾及毘沙門天王等一切大眾，皆大歡喜信受奉行。
english: At that time, after the World-Honored One had finished expounding this sutra, the bodhisattva-mahasattvas, devas, humans, the four assemblies, and all the great assembly including Vaiśravaṇa and the other heavenly kings, all rejoiced greatly and faithfully received and practiced it.

chinese: 」時即佛微告馬鳴菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the Buddha subtly told Bodhisattva Ashvaghosha: "Excellent!

chinese: 大丈夫！
english: No problem!

chinese: 汝速可說可說。
english: Quickly speak, speak!

chinese: 」「唯然。
english: "Yes, indeed."

chinese: 世尊愍念我聽說。
english: The World-Honored One, out of compassion, allowed me to speak.

chinese: 」合掌歡喜從口中放大光明，說光中神呪曰：「曩謨三曼多沒他那迦迦馬鳴吃哩吒囉佉吒囉佉莎縛訶」「若欲受持此法，先從師盡財利布施供給，受習印契真言。
english: The palms joined together in joy, from the mouth a great radiance was emitted, and speaking the divine mantra within the light, it said: "Namo samanta buddhānāṃ kāma-ming kṛṭa rākha ṭa rākha svāhā." "If one wishes to receive and uphold this dharma, one must first offer all wealth and possessions to the teacher as dana, then receive instruction in the mudras and mantras."

chinese: 則畫作菩薩像，色相白肉色而合掌，坐白蓮華，乘白馬，著白色衣，以瓔珞莊嚴身，首戴花冠，垂右足。
english: Then paint the image of a bodhisattva, with a white flesh-colored complexion and hands joined in prayer, sitting on a white lotus flower, riding a white horse, wearing white garments, with the body adorned with jeweled ornaments, wearing a flower crown on the head, with the right foot hanging down.

chinese: 畫像了，泥壇。
english: The portrait is finished, the clay altar.

chinese: 始自三月三日，東面像向西，以種種廣大供具、蘇乳蘇燈供養。
english: From the beginning on the third day of the third month, with the eastern image facing west, offerings were made with various kinds of extensive offering implements, ghee milk, and ghee lamps.

chinese: 二十八日乃至百日，須清淨潔淨。
english: For twenty-eight days up to one hundred days, one must maintain purity and cleanliness.

chinese: 比丘及傳法利生之師，恩不已失，時我常檀那家及國土放大光明，成就錦繡羅綿財絹縺緻之類，金寶積如山岳，世間受用咨。
english: The bhikkhus and masters who transmit the Dharma for the benefit of beings, their kindness is never lost. At that time, I constantly [caused] the homes of donors and the lands to emit great radiance, accomplishing brocades, silks, gauze, cotton, wealth, silk fabrics, and fine textiles. Gold and treasures accumulated like mountains and peaks, providing for worldly use and enjoyment.

chinese: 「若有一國一人修行，我本誓故，普天率土民家皆悉如前所說，財利莊嚴具成就。
english: "If in a single country even one person cultivates [this practice], by virtue of my original vow, all households throughout the land under heaven will, as previously stated, attain complete fulfillment of wealth and magnificent adornments."

chinese: 一人莫乏有患，我本願皆悉為莊嚴財寶。
english: No one should lack or suffer; I originally vowed to become magnificent treasures for all.

chinese: 於若法至疑惑之心，發起不信之念，不成就一世之願故，後世之果不定。
english: If doubts and confusion arise in one's mind regarding the Dharma, and thoughts of disbelief emerge, one will not fulfill the vow of this lifetime, and therefore the fruit of the next life will be uncertain.

chinese: 好好以堅固之情歸於法，非忌傳授之德，我必日日時時加護念，圓滿世間第一妙樂之財利。
english: With firm devotion, return to the Dharma with excellence. Without begrudging the virtue of transmission, I will surely protect and be mindful of you day by day, moment by moment, fulfilling the wealth and benefits of the world's foremost sublime joy.

chinese: 如向所說，係念本誓，向寶壇前作契印念誦。
english: As previously stated, mindfully recalling the original vow, face the jeweled altar and perform the mudra while reciting.

chinese: 屈左中指無名指，以大母指押彼二指甲，舒頭指及小指安心上，右手把數珠念真言，此名玉環成就一切所願印。
english: Bend the left middle finger and ring finger, press those two fingernails with the thumb, extend the index finger and little finger and place them on the heart, hold the prayer beads with the right hand and recite the mantra. This is called the Jade Ring Mudra for Accomplishing All Wishes.

chinese: 此契印，末代愚學之妄，不可記於文字。
english: This seal is the delusion of ignorant students in the final age; it cannot be recorded in writing.

chinese: 萬人中撰十人，十人之中撰一人，許可。
english: From ten thousand people, select ten; from those ten people, select one—this is acceptable.

chinese: 於二膝上各坐一孩子，以左懷中抱一孩子，於右手中持吉祥菓。
english: On each of her two knees sits a child, in her left arm she holds a child, and in her right hand she holds an auspicious fruit.

chinese: 畫師應受八戒，其彩色中不用皮膠。
english: The painter should observe the eight precepts and not use hide glue in their pigments.

chinese: 畫像成已，淨治一室嚴儀塗拭，以香作方壇，置像壇中，以種種華散於壇上。
english: When the painted image is completed, thoroughly clean a room and solemnly prepare it by wiping it clean. Make a square altar with incense, place the image in the center of the altar, and scatter various flowers upon the altar.

chinese: 復以甘脆飲食、乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水，燒沈水香而供養。
english: Again offering sweet and delicate foods and drinks, milk porridge, yogurt rice, various fruits, argha perfumed water, and burning aloeswood incense as offerings.

chinese: 像面向西，持誦者面東，對像念誦，每日三時，時別誦一千遍。
english: The image faces west, the reciter faces east, chanting while facing the image. Three times daily, reciting one thousand times at each session.

chinese: 取月生五日起首，先誦萬遍，然後對像前念誦，所求一切事皆悉圓滿。
english: Starting from the fifth day of the lunar month, first recite ten thousand times, then recite before the image, and all matters that are sought will be completely fulfilled.

chinese: 「又法女人欲得男女者，月經後澡浴，取黃母子同色者，乳一升置銀器中。
english: "Another method: If a woman wishes to have children, after her menstrual period she should bathe, then take one sheng of milk from a yellow cow and her calf of the same color, and place it in a silver vessel.

chinese: 以右手無名指攪乳，誦真言加持一千八十遍，然後取服，至日內則得有胎。
english: Stir the milk with the ring finger of the right hand, recite the mantra and empower it one thousand and eighty times, then take and consume it. Within days, conception will be achieved.

chinese: 「又法欲令他人歡喜敬愛者，或飲食菓子或華或香加持一百八遍，於真言句中加彼人名，將與彼人，則得歡喜。
english: "Another method: If you wish to make others joyful and respectful toward you, take food, drink, fruits, flowers, or incense and recite mantras over them one hundred and eight times. Within the mantra verses, add that person's name. When you give these to that person, they will become joyful."

chinese: 「又法若有人作留難口舌者，畫彼人形，左脚踏之，誦真言一千八十遍則得無難。
english: "Another method: If there is someone who creates obstacles and slander, draw that person's form, step on it with the left foot, and recite the mantra one thousand and eighty times, then you will be free from difficulties."

chinese: 「又法欲令一切人歡喜，取牛黃末置銀器中，准前以無名指攪，誦真言加持一百八遍，點於額上，一切人見皆歡喜順伏。
english: "Another method: If you wish to make all people rejoice, take powdered bezoar and place it in a silver vessel. As before, stir with the ring finger while reciting the mantra and empowering it one hundred and eight times. Apply it to the forehead, and all people who see it will rejoice and submit obediently."

chinese: 「又法若新衣服，對像前加持一百八遍，然後取著，一切人見亦皆歡喜敬愛。
english: "Another method: if you have new clothes, recite the mantra 108 times before the image, then wear them. All people who see you will feel joy and show respect and affection."

chinese: 「又法若有惡夢，誦真言一百八遍，則得惡夢消除。
english: "Another method: if there are nightmares, recite the true words one hundred and eight times, then the nightmares will be eliminated."

chinese: 「又法若月蝕時，取酥五兩置器中，以金筯攪，無間斷念誦加持，乃至月却得圓滿為限。
english: "Another method: When there is a lunar eclipse, take five ounces of ghee and place it in a vessel. Stir it with golden chopsticks without interruption while reciting mantras and performing empowerment, continuing until the moon returns to fullness."

chinese: 然後取一分供養訶利帝母，餘者漸喫，即有胎孕，所生男女聰慧福德。
english: Then take one portion to make an offering to Hariti, and gradually consume the rest. This will lead to pregnancy, and the sons and daughters born will be intelligent and blessed with good fortune.

chinese: 又法取牛膝根作齒木，加持一百八遍嚼及揩齒，所出言詞令人樂聞，意欲所求他人之事皆得隨意成就。
english: Another method: take the root of achyranthes bidentata and make it into a tooth-stick. Recite mantras over it one hundred and eight times, then chew it and clean your teeth with it. The words you speak will cause people to delight in hearing them, and whatever you wish to seek or accomplish through others will all be achieved according to your will.

chinese: 又法欲得壽命長遠者，取骨屢草嫩苗搵蘇蜜酪護摩七夜，夜別誦真言一千八，火中則長壽。
english: Another method: For those who wish to obtain longevity, take the tender shoots of gulou grass, dip them in butter, honey, and yogurt, and perform homa for seven nights. Each night recite the mantra one thousand and eight times into the fire, and you will attain long life.

chinese: 「又法欲得所為所作隨意成就者，每月生五日二十日，塗道場散華，種種飲食乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水，燒沈香薰陸以用供養。
english: "Another method: For those who wish to have their undertakings and actions succeed according to their will, on the fifth and twentieth days of each lunar month, prepare the ritual ground and scatter flowers. Offer various foods and drinks, milk porridge, curd rice, and various fruits, as well as argha water and incense. Burn aloes wood and frankincense as offerings."

chinese: 先供養一切如來、文殊師利菩薩、普賢等一切菩薩，然後供養我訶利帝母。
english: First make offerings to all Tathagatas, to Manjushri Bodhisattva, to Samantabhadra and all other Bodhisattvas, then afterwards make offerings to me, Hariti Mother.

chinese: 何以故？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 我本藥叉女，如來與我三歸五戒菩提心律儀戒，對諸十地菩薩故，是先供養諸佛菩薩。
english: I am originally a yaksha woman. The Tathagata gave me the Three Refuges, Five Precepts, and the Bodhicitta vows and disciplinary precepts. Before all the Tenth Stage Bodhisattvas, I first make offerings to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

chinese: 供養已，對此像前誦一萬遍，所求事業皆得滿足。
english: After making offerings, recite ten thousand times before this image, and all desired undertakings will be fulfilled.

chinese: 「訶利帝母念誦法。
english: "Hariti Mother Recitation Method."

chinese: 「愛子心真言：「知尾知娑嚩」「印，合掌屈二大拇指入掌中，誦心真言供養訖，於頂上放二大拇指即散去。
english: The Heart Mantra of Aiko: "Chibi Chisaba." The mudra: Join palms and bend both thumbs into the palms. After reciting the heart mantra and making offerings, release the two thumbs above the crown of the head and then separate the hands.

chinese: 請召、發遣皆此印。
english: Summons, dispatches, and deployments all [use] this seal.

chinese: 以白檀香橫量六指作童子形，具足兩手，各把菓子與人，頭上作三髻角子。
english: Make a child figure from white sandalwood measuring six finger-widths across, complete with both hands, each holding fruit to give to people, with three horn-shaped topknots on the head.

chinese: 於閑處安置，誦真言遍，即現身問言：『喚我何事？
english: In a quiet place, set up and recite the mantra completely. Then [the deity] will manifest and ask: "Why have you called me?"

chinese: 』隨心答之。
english: He answered according to his heart.

chinese: 取黃牛肉方寸，一加持一燒，日三時，滿四日得大自在隨意。
english: Take one square inch of yellow ox meat, each time holding it and burning it, three times daily. After completing four days, one obtains great freedom at will.

chinese: 「又法牛肉、香為丸，月八日時念誦，燒上香八遍。
english: "Another method: Make pills from beef and incense. On the eighth day of the month, while reciting incantations, burn the finest incense eight times."

chinese: 至日已，夜半現大光相，得大神力。
english: When the day came, at midnight a great light appeared and obtained great divine power.

chinese: 安香為丸，一加持一燒，日三時，時別一千八遍，五日調伏一切人。
english: Make pills with benzoin, perform one blessing and one burning, three times daily, one thousand and eight times per session, and in five days you will subdue all people.

chinese: 「又法百草花一一加持散身上，得千人衣食。
english: "Another method: take the flowers of a hundred herbs, bless each one and scatter them on the body, and you will obtain clothing and food for a thousand people."

chinese: 「又法日誦真言燒蘇合香七日，見地下金藏。
english: "Another method: Recite the mantra daily while burning storax incense for seven days, and you will see golden treasures underground."

chinese: 種種花菓飲食壇中供養，日日如是，得一切財寶。
english: Various flowers, fruits, drinks, and food are offered in the altar. Doing this daily, one obtains all manner of wealth and treasures.

chinese: 「又法安和乳粥，一加持一燒七日，日三時，時別一千八遍，現身共語意問。
english: "Another method: Use peaceful and harmonious milk porridge, with each empowerment burn it once for seven days, three times daily, one thousand and eight times per session, and [the deity] will appear in person to speak with you and answer your questions."

chinese: 「又法被禁閉，誦一萬遍即解脫。
english: "Another method: if one is imprisoned, reciting [this] ten thousand times will bring liberation."

chinese: 治病，加持菴羅菓，乳中漬燒加持，除一切病。
english: To cure illness, bless amala fruit, soak it in milk, burn it while blessed, and it will eliminate all diseases.
